source: Oh hey, guys! Good morning! You’re all up early!
translation: 哦，嘿，各位！早上好！你们都起得真早！

source: Good morning, Aiden.
translation: 早上好，Aiden。

source: Eh? What’s going on over there?
translation: 诶？那边在做什么？

source: Lloyd is doing some palm reading while we’re drinking coffee to start our day.
translation: 我们喝咖啡开始新的一天，Lloyd正在给大家看手相。

source: Oh~ Sounds interesting.
translation: 哦～听起来很有趣。

source: N-Not gonna lie, this is probably the longest time a guy has held my hand.
translation: 不、不瞒你们说，这大概是一个男人握着我的手最久的一次。

source: Hey, Aiden! Let me read yours!
translation: 嘿，Aiden！让我看看你的！

source: Hmm… You seem to have a broken lifeline…
translation: 嗯……你的生命线好像断了……

source: What?! Broken?! Does that mean I’m gonna die?!
translation: 什么？！断了？！这是不是意味着我要死了？！

source: N-No! A lifeline is the part of the hand between the index finger and thumb, making a curve below the thumb.
translation: 不、不是！生命线是食指和拇指之间、在拇指下方弯曲的那条掌纹。

source: Eh…? But the name sounds really bad…
translation: 诶……？可这个名字听起来很不吉利……

source: Relax! It just means that it reflects losses, struggles, unexpected changes, and interruptions in a person’s lifestyle.
translation: 放松！这只代表一个人的生活中会有失去、挣扎、意外变化和中断。

source: Thinking about it, it makes sense, right?! Because you weren’t used to the hotel lifestyle before!
translation: 仔细想想很有道理，对吧？！因为你之前不习惯酒店里的生活！

source: Whoa! He’s right! That’s amazing!
translation: 哇！他说得对！太神奇了！

source: Ah, gotcha…!
translation: 啊，明白了……！

source: Not sure if this is just a youngster’s thing… But is it really alright for you guys to be basing your ‘destiny’ and ‘future’ on the creases of your hands…?
translation: 不知道这是不是年轻人的玩意儿……但你们真的能根据手上的褶皱判断自己的“命运”和“未来”吗……？

source: Lloyd is doing it for fun. I just like to play along.
translation: Lloyd只是闹着玩。我喜欢配合他。

source: Listening to his magic first thing in the morning is entertaining with hot cocoa.
translation: 一大早喝着热可可，听他讲魔法，很有意思。

source: Heyyy! There are plenty of studies that discuss these mystic energies! It’s totally legit!
translation: 喂——！有很多研究都讨论过这些神秘能量！完全有依据！

source: Yes, I believe you.
translation: 是的，我相信你。

source: Besides, it’s a nice ice breaker~!
translation: 而且这也是个很好的破冰话题～！

source: By the way, where’s Yoshi? He’d normally still be asleep, but it looks like he’s already left.
translation: 对了，Yoshi在哪里？平时这个时候他还在睡，可现在好像已经出去了。

source: Oh, he went out not too long before you got up. I’m not sure what for though…
translation: 哦，你起床前不久他就出去了。不过我不知道去做什么……

source: He did seem to be in a hurry… He didn’t even drink his coffee…
translation: 他看起来确实很着急……连咖啡都没喝……

source: Hehe, knowing Yoshi, maybe he’s already getting a head start and working on the site.
translation: 嘿嘿，以Yoshi的性格，也许已经提前去工地开工了。

source: Though I gotta say, I’m pretty surprised you’re up at a normal-person schedule, Jin.
translation: 不过不得不说，Jin，你居然按正常人的作息起床，真让我惊讶。

source: A-Ahh... Yeah… It’s still been kind of difficult, but Sir Goro suggested I try a morning coffee, and that’s helped a lot.
translation: 啊、啊……是啊……还是有点困难，不过Goro先生建议我早上喝咖啡，确实很有帮助。

source: I can’t work well without it, so I thought it’d give Jin a boost.
translation: 没有咖啡我就无法好好工作，所以觉得它也能让Jin提起精神。

source: It’s crazy to me that you’re drinking yours iced, considering how cold it is outside, Jin! You sure are tougher than you look.
translation: 外面这么冷，你居然还喝冰咖啡，真是太疯狂了，Jin！你可比看起来强悍。

source: I believe drinking scalding black coffee alone with no cream or sugar like Sir Goro is a lot more concerning…
translation: 我觉得像Goro先生那样独自喝滚烫、不加奶也不加糖的黑咖啡，才更令人担心……

source: *ehem* I prefer it this way.
translation: *咳咳* 我就喜欢这样。

source: Either way, we’re all gonna need the energy! I assume we’ll be clearing out snow till we can’t feel our fingers again.
translation: 不管怎样，我们都需要补充能量！今天大概又要清雪，清到手指失去知觉。

source: Don’t worry, Jin! It’s gonna be a good morning exercise after all!
translation: 别担心，Jin！这毕竟是一场很好的晨练！

source: Just think of it as part of your road to being physically fit! Physically fit, fit, fit!
translation: 就把它当成强身健体之路的一部分！健体、体、体！

source: Hehe… Seems like the coffee’s kicking in for Lloyd.
translation: 嘿嘿……看来咖啡开始对Lloyd起效了。

source: On that note, I guess we should get dressed and start our day as well.
translation: 既然如此，我们也该换好衣服，开始今天的工作了。

source: Yeah, we can’t let Yoshi finish everything up without us, haha!
translation: 是啊，不能让Yoshi趁我们不在，把一切都做完，哈哈！

source: Oh! Yoshi’s over there by the arch! And it looks like he’s with some people!
translation: 哦！Yoshi就在拱门旁边！而且好像和一些人在一起！

source: Huh? Do we have visitors?
translation: 嗯？有客人来了吗？

source: Hold on… Isn’t that—
translation: 等等……那不是——

source: Ah! Perfect timing! There they are!
translation: 啊！来得正好！他们来了！

source: Whoa! I can’t believe it!
translation: 哇！真不敢相信！

source: Hello, Sir Aiden and Sir Goro!
translation: 你们好，Aiden先生、Goro先生！

source: Ah, welcome scouts! I wasn’t expecting a visit from all of you.
translation: 啊，欢迎你们，童子军！没想到大家都会来。

source: We’re sorry for coming at such short notice!
translation: 抱歉这么突然就来了！

source: Hey, bro! Long time, no see!
translation: 嘿，兄弟！好久不见！

source: Wah, I just realized how much I missed you all! Hahaha!
translation: 哇，我这才意识到有多想念大家！哈哈哈！

source: Yoshi! How come you didn’t tell us that the gang was coming over today?!
translation: Yoshi！你怎么没告诉我们这群小子今天要来？！

source: W-Well, I figured it would be better as a surprise.
translation: 这、这个嘛，我觉得当作惊喜会更好。

source: So, what brings you boys back here?
translation: 那么，是什么把你们几个带回来了？

source: We’re reporting for duty, sir!
translation: 我们来报到工作，先生！

source: Yeah, we’re here to help you guys clear out the snow.
translation: 是啊，我们来帮大家清雪。

source: Heh~ I ain’t gonna miss the chance to flex my muscles!
translation: 嘿～我可不会错过展示肌肉的机会！

source: Besides, the pups were tired of being cooped up indoors, so I thought they could run around here for a while.
translation: 而且小狗们在屋里闷烦了，我想可以让它们来这里跑一阵。

source: It’ll get very cold in the evenings so everyone, including the pups, can stay in the cabins for the night.
translation: 晚上会很冷，所以大家包括小狗，都可以在小屋里过夜。

source: I assume you’re the one who informed the scouts of our situation, Yoshinori?
translation: 我想是你把这里的情况告诉童子军的，Yoshinori？

source: Yes, sir. I figured we could really use the extra hands to get things done, so I called Yoichi and Taiga yesterday.
translation: 是的，先生。我觉得确实需要更多人手，所以昨天给Yoichi和Taiga打了电话。

source: Everyone’s been at Keitaro’s place since the snowstorm, and we wanted to come over when we heard the camp needed help!
translation: 暴风雪以来，大家一直住在Keitaro家；听说营地需要帮助，我们就想赶过来！

source: Stupid Wolfboy didn’t know how to use my phone and put Scoutmaster Yoshi on loudspeaker.
translation: 笨蛋Wolfboy不会用我的手机，把Yoshi童子军长的电话开了免提。

source: Hey! You should be thanking me, Torch-head! You’re the one who wanted to come back here the most!
translation: 喂！你应该感谢我，Torch-head！明明是你最想回到这里！

source: Hehe, I figured it would be a lot more fun if everyone came along, so I invited them too!
translation: 嘿嘿，我觉得大家一起来会有趣得多，所以也邀请了他们！

source: Hehe~ You sure it’s not just an excuse to see the scouts again, Yoshi?
translation: 嘿嘿～你确定这不是想再见童子军的借口，Yoshi？

source: Are you boys sure it’s alright to spend the day working here, though? You aren’t skipping your studies, are you?
translation: 不过你们确定能花一天时间在这里工作吗？没有逃课吧？

source: Nah. Classes got cancelled thanks to the weather, so we’ve been stuck at home for days now!
translation: 没有。因为天气原因停课，我们已经困在家里好几天了！

source: It was getting boring with these dorks too; all we do is just sit around and play stupid video games.
translation: 和这些笨蛋待着也越来越无聊；我们整天就只是坐着玩蠢游戏。

source: Heh, just tell them you just suck at it.
translation: 呵，直接告诉他们你游戏玩得很烂就好。

source: Sh-Shut up!
translation: 闭、闭嘴！

source: Don’t worry, Sir Goro! We’re really excited to be back! A buddy is always ready to help, after all!
translation: 别担心，Goro先生！能回来我们真的很兴奋！毕竟伙伴时刻准备着帮助别人！

source: I hope this many people is enough, though. I tried inviting Eduard and Lee, but they’re both busy today.
translation: 不过希望这么多人已经够了。我试着邀请Eduard和Lee，但他们今天都有事。

source: I called Felix and Seto too, but they’re away on a vacation, sadly.
translation: 我也给Felix和Seto打了电话，可惜他们出去度假了。

source: It’s alright! You guys are a huge help already!
translation: 没关系！你们已经帮了大忙！

source: It’s a bit of a shame you boys have to see the camp in this state.
translation: 让你们几个看到营地现在的样子，真有点遗憾。

source: I think the snow cover is really pretty, though...
translation: 不过我觉得覆满白雪的样子真的很漂亮……

source: Hehe, don’t forget we’re here to get rid of it.
translation: 嘿嘿，别忘了我们来这里就是为了清掉它。

source: I’ve heard there’s plenty of new stuff being developed for the next term! It makes me excited to come back next summer!
translation: 听说下期活动正在开发许多新东西！让我很期待明年夏天回来！

source: I guess we’re getting an exclusive sneak peek, then!
translation: 看来我们能独家提前一睹为快了！

source: That’s not the only new thing I see though… I see some unfamiliar faces as well…
translation: 不过新东西可不止这些……我还看到了几张陌生面孔……

source: Oh yeah, you guys haven’t met the new crew!
translation: 哦，对了，你们还没见过新成员！

source: Yoichi did mention there were new people working for the project.
translation: Yoichi确实提过，有新人在参与这个项目。

source: Ah, of course! Sorry for not introducing them right away, I got caught up with the reunion!
translation: 啊，当然！抱歉没马上介绍，我沉浸在重逢里了！

source: Everyone, these are the new developers that Mr. Clermont hired to help with the expansion project!
translation: 各位，这些是Clermont先生雇来协助扩建项目的新开发人员！

source: This is Hyunjin, he’s in charge of the technology department!
translation: 这是Hyunjin，他负责技术部门！

source: Wow! Camp Buddy is gonna be high-tech?!
translation: 哇！伙伴营要变成高科技营地了吗？！

source: N-Not necessarily, I’m just here to make things easier on the management with some modern adjustments.
translation: 也、也不一定，我只是在这里进行一些现代化调整，让管理工作更方便。

source: Like for example, I’ve updated the camp’s website to allow online enrollment and developed a database for all important camp records.
translation: 例如，我更新了营地网站，使其支持网上报名，还为所有重要营地记录开发了数据库。

source: Yeah, we don’t have to read through tons and tons of application forms like we did last term!
translation: 是啊，我们不用像上期那样阅读堆积如山的申请表了！

source: Wow, that sounds like a huge upgrade!
translation: 哇，听起来是一次巨大升级！

source: Jin has quite a few more upgrades he’s working on as well, but I was relieved to see that none of them would disrupt the spirit of the camp.
translation: Jin还在开发另外一些升级，不过我很欣慰，它们都不会破坏营地的精神。

source: These two are Lloyd and Darius. They’re in charge of designing and building all the new facilities.
translation: 这两位是Lloyd和Darius。他们负责设计和建造所有新设施。

source: Mr. Sirius! Master Architect!
translation: Sirius先生！建筑大师！

source: I’m Dar, lead foreman. I build stuff.
translation: 我是Dar，工头。我负责盖东西。

source: Don’t mistake pipsqueak here for a scout like I did, he’s actually twice our age.
translation: 别像我一样，把这个小不点误认成童子军，他其实有我们两倍大。

source: P-Pipsqueak!?
translation: 小、Pipsqueak？！

source: Hehe… I like that nickname.
translation: 嘿嘿……我喜欢这个绰号。

source: Wow, an architect and a construction foreman… That sounds so official.
translation: 哇，建筑师和施工工头……听起来真专业。

source: Oh, they’re the real deal. I’ve already learned a thing or two about design and carpentry from them.
translation: 哦，他们可是货真价实的专家。我已经从他们那里学了些设计和木工知识。

source: You’re very crafty, Taiga.
translation: 你很心灵手巧，Taiga。

source: We have a team of construction workers too, but they’re on leave for a couple more days.
translation: 我们还有一支施工队，不过他们还要休假几天。

source: Aren’t we missing someone…? I haven’t seen Ms. Yuri around.
translation: 是不是少了一个人……？我一直没看到Yuri小姐。

source: Oh, she’s still at the cabin! She’s been taking care of one of our other crew. You guys will meet them later, as soon as they’re ready!
translation: 哦，她还在小屋里！一直在照顾另一名成员。等对方准备好，你们稍后就能见面！

source: It’s so interesting to see everyone not wearing our uniforms for once! I think our scoutmasters look really ‘cool’!
translation: 难得看到大家没有穿制服，真有意思！我觉得童子军长们看起来真的很“酷”！

source: Suck up.
translation: 马屁精。

source: You don’t get it, Yoichi? Cool! Cause it’s cold!
translation: 你没听懂吗，Yoichi？很酷！因为天气很冷！

source: No one cares! That is so freaking lame!!
translation: 没人在乎！这个笑话逊爆了！！

source: *ehem* Anyway, thank you all for volunteering to help. We were a bit worried about the lack of manpower yesterday.
translation: *咳咳* 总之，谢谢大家自愿来帮忙。昨天我们确实有些担心人手不足。

source: You’ve all already done so much for the camp during your term that it feels a bit embarrassing to ask for more, but I’m grateful nonetheless.
translation: 你们在活动期间已经为营地做了很多，再请大家付出更多让我有些不好意思，但我仍然无比感激。

source: It’s our pleasure, Sir Goro! We’re just excited to be back here before the next summer term! We’ve all missed it!
translation: 这是我们的荣幸，Goro先生！能在下个夏季活动前回到这里，我们都很兴奋！大家一直很想念营地！

source: I know it’s only been a few months, but I could hardly wait to see everyone again!
translation: 我知道才过去几个月，但已经迫不及待想再见到大家！

source: You boys are the best scouts a scoutmaster could ask for!
translation: 你们是童子军长所能期望的最棒童子军！

source: In all my years here, I’ve never seen a group of scouts that have the same sense of unity and camaraderie that you have for each other and the camp!
translation: 在这里这么多年，我从没见过一群童子军像你们一样，对彼此和营地拥有如此强烈的团结与友情！

source: It’s such an honor to know that you’re a true testament to what this place stands for!
translation: 知道你们真正诠释了这里所代表的精神，是莫大的荣幸！

source: *sigh* Bet you guys didn’t miss the speeches…
translation: *叹气* 我猜你们肯定没想念这些演讲……

source: All of you are truly living the ‘Buddy Oath’ to your core, just like a true scout!
translation: 你们都像真正的童子军一样，从心底践行着“伙伴誓言”！

source: Like the second Buddy Law states, ‘Always help a buddy in need!’ And by volunteering to come here today, you’ve truly fulfilled—
translation: 就像伙伴守则第二条所说，“永远帮助需要帮助的伙伴！”而你们今天自愿前来，真正履行了——

source: BUTTCHEEKS! Do you have any food for us? I’m starving!
translation: BUTTCHEEKS！有东西给我们吃吗？我快饿死了！

source: Yoichi! We haven’t even started working yet…
translation: Yoichi！我们甚至还没开始工作……

source: Either way, I’m here to the save the day! Since today is turning out to be special, it’s only fair I cook something good too!
translation: 不管怎样，我来拯救今天！既然今天变得如此特别，我当然也该做些好吃的！

source: Ooh, ooh! Can I help you out, bro?! I miss the kitchen here, it’s so much bigger than the one at home!
translation: 哦哦！我能帮忙吗，兄弟？！我好想念这里的厨房，比家里的大多了！

source: Hey! No avoiding chores, Torch-head!
translation: 喂！不准逃避杂活，Torch-head！

source: Shush, Wolfboy.
translation: 闭嘴，Wolfboy。

source: As happy as I am to have my little chef again, you can leave the kitchen work to me and spend fun time with everyone else!
translation: 虽然很高兴小厨师又回来了，但厨房工作交给我，你去和其他人开心相聚吧！

source: Aww~ I missed being called ‘little chef’!
translation: 哎呀～我好想念“小厨师”这个称呼！

source: I’ll just call everyone when the food is ready!
translation: 饭做好后，我会叫大家！

source: *sigh* Alright… I did promise to shovel today.
translation: *叹气* 好吧……我确实答应今天要铲雪。

source: Gimme those damn shovels and let’s get this over with! The more I shovel, the more food I’ll get!
translation: 把那些该死的铲子给我，赶紧干完！铲得越多，我就能吃得越多！

source: GRAHHH!!! I’m pumped up!
translation: 嘎啊啊！！！我燃起来了！

source: Does Yoichi realize that it doesn’t work that way…? We’ll get food regardless of how much we shovel…
translation: Yoichi知道事情不是这么算的吗……？无论铲多少雪，我们都能吃到饭……

source: I think it’s fine to let Yoichi do his thing. I mean, he’ll get a lot more work done this way.
translation: 我觉得就让Yoichi照自己的方式来吧。这样他反而能完成更多工作。

source: Am I gonna end up cleaning up after him again…? I bet he’ll just throw the snow at random places.
translation: 最后是不是又要我替他收拾残局……？我敢说他只会把雪随便乱扔。

source: Hehe, by the looks of things, he’s doing just that.
translation: 嘿嘿，看起来他正是这么做的。

source: Ugh, he’s such a meathead.
translation: 呃，他真是个四肢发达的笨蛋。

source: I-I don’t think he’s shoveling the right place either… The site’s way over there…
translation: 我、我觉得他铲的地方也不对……工地明明在那边……

source: *sigh* I’ll go tell him.
translation: *叹气* 我去告诉他。

source: Let’s make sure you boys are all properly geared up before we get to work.
translation: 开工前，先确保你们几个都穿戴好合适装备。

source: The snow boots should be in the shed. Come with me, scouts!
translation: 雪地靴应该在棚屋里。跟我来，童子军！

source: What a lively bunch, aren’t they?
translation: 真是一群活力十足的小子，对吧？

source: Oh yeah, they’re chaotic. But in a good way!
translation: 是啊，他们很闹腾。不过是好的那种！

source: Hahaha, it looks like Sir Goro’s just as excited that the scouts are back and he just won’t admit it.
translation: 哈哈哈，看来Goro先生也同样为童子军回来而兴奋，只是不肯承认。

source: Just like how he was as a scoutmaster.
translation: 和他当童子军长时一模一样。

source: It feels really nostalgic… It reminds me of how we used to be back then.
translation: 真让人怀念……让我想起了当年的我们。

source: Yeah… I miss being a scout too.
translation: 是啊……我也怀念当童子军的日子。

source: Now I feel like I missed out. I never went to a summer camp in my younger days.
translation: 现在感觉自己错过了很多。年轻时我从没参加过夏令营。

source: Don’t worry, Jin! I’d say having you here working with us counts!
translation: 别担心，Jin！我觉得你在这里和我们一起工作，也算参加了！

source: We may be here at Camp Buddy for a different reason this time, but our experiences together will forever be a part of us, no matter where we are in life!
translation: 这次来到伙伴营的理由或许不同，但无论人生走到哪里，我们共同的经历都会永远成为自己的一部分！

source: I know you guys have been successful with your careers, but know that Camp Buddy’s doors are always open to welcome you back!
translation: 我知道大家的事业都很成功，但请记住，伙伴营的大门永远敞开，欢迎你们回来！

source: Don’t get carried away with a speech again, Yoshi. Hahaha!
translation: 别又沉浸在演讲里了，Yoshi。哈哈哈！

source: Either way, that is very touching…
translation: 不管怎样，确实很感人……

source: Anyway, should we go start today’s shift? We don’t want the scouts doing all the work, right?
translation: 总之，我们该开始今天的工作了吗？总不能让童子军把活全干了，对吧？

source: Yeah, I think that’s enough reunions for one day. We have a long day ahead.
translation: 是啊，今天的重逢到这里就够了。前面还有漫长的一天。

source: I’ll head to the kitchen and start cooking!
translation: 我去厨房开始做饭！

source: Let’s make this a productive day, everyone!
translation: 各位，让今天成为富有成果的一天！

source: Looks like everyone’s divided into groups and working hard already!
translation: 看来大家已经分成小组，开始努力工作了！

source: With all the extra help, we’ll be done in no time!
translation: 有了这些额外帮助，很快就能完成！

source: Using three shovels at the same time won’t make your work faster, Yoichi!
translation: 同时用三把铲子并不会让你干得更快，Yoichi！

source: I’ll make you eat your words, Mr. Perfect!
translation: 我会让你收回这句话的，Mr. Perfect！

source: Hey there, guys! I hear Yoichi’s being a bit unruly again.
translation: 嘿，各位！听说Yoichi又有点不守规矩了。

source: It’s nothing new honestly. At least he’s getting a lot done.
translation: 说实话，这没什么新鲜的。至少他确实干了很多。

source: You know how Yoichi is, he has to make it fun in his own way!
translation: 你知道Yoichi的性格，他非得用自己的方式把事情变得有趣！

source: Yeah, if we’re gonna get conned by these boomers into free labor, might as well make it entertaining, right?
translation: 是啊，既然要被这些老家伙骗来当免费劳工，至少得让过程有趣点，对吧？

source: Y-Yoichi…! D-Don’t listen to him, he’s being silly…!
translation: 洋、Yoichi……！别、别听他的，他在胡说……！

source: Hehe, he’s got a point.
translation: 嘿嘿，他说得有道理。

source: Hmm, if I had to guess, based on your bold behavior, Yoichi – you’re either an Aries or an Aquarius!
translation: 嗯，让我根据你大胆的行为猜猜，Yoichi——你不是白羊座，就是水瓶座！

source: A what?!
translation: 什么座？！

source: He’s guessing your horoscope.
translation: 他在猜你的星座。

source: Homoscope?!
translation: 同性座？！

source: Oh! I’ve heard of that before, when I worked on my stargazing badge!
translation: 哦！我以前争取观星徽章时听说过！

source: What is this mumbo jumbo?
translation: 这是什么乱七八糟的东西？

source: A horoscope is an ancient way to determine someone’s future, typically including a description of personalities or circumstances, based on the relative positions of the stars and planets at the time of that person's birth!
translation: 星座占卜是一种古老的未来预测方法，通常根据某人出生时恒星与行星的相对位置，描述其性格或境遇！

source: You’re really a walking dictionary, huh Natsumi?
translation: 你真是一本行走的字典，对吧，Natsumi？

source: Wow, somebody has done their homework!
translation: 哇，有人真是做足了功课！

source: Haha, Natsumi is officially the best scout we have, and for three terms in a row now!
translation: 哈哈，Natsumi可是我们正式评选的最佳童子军，而且已经连续三期了！

source: In my entire time at the camp, nobody else has earned more badges than him!
translation: 我在营地这么多年，没有其他人获得的徽章比他更多！

source: Pfft… Lame.
translation: 噗……逊爆了。

source: Aww, Scoutmaster Yoshi! That’s really flattering!
translation: 哎呀，Yoshi童子军长！您太过奖了！

source: With how professional and commanding you sound, I’m guessing you’re a Capricorn?
translation: 听您说话这么专业又有威严，我猜你是摩羯座？

source: Close, I’m a Gemini!
translation: 差一点，我是双子座！

source: Oh, drats!
translation: 哦，可恶！

source: You were right about Yoichi, though! He’s an Aquarius based on his birthday.
translation: 不过你猜对了Yoichi！按生日看，他是水瓶座。

source: Scoutmaster Yoshi is a Pisces and Taiga is a Cancer.
translation: Yoshi童子军长是双鱼座，Taiga是巨蟹座。

source: You called Dynamite a WHAT?!
translation: 你说Dynamite是什么病？！

source: Dumbass, you’re thinking of a different cancer.
translation: 笨蛋，你想到的是另一种“癌症”。

source: I only know the signs according to the months, though. I’m really interested to know more about them!
translation: 不过我只知道每个月对应的星座。真想了解更多！

source: R-Really…?
translation: 真、真的吗……？

source: Yeah! I think it’s cool! I’m sure Hunter would like it too!
translation: 是啊！我觉得很酷！Hunter肯定也会喜欢！

source: Y-You think… it’s COOL?!
translation: 你、你觉得……很酷？！

source: You and Lloyd are gonna get along just fine.
translation: 你和Lloyd一定会相处得很好。

source: We have GOT to have a mini divination session as soon we’re done today!
translation: 今天完工后，我们一定要来一场小型占卜！

source: Hehe, isn’t he cute?
translation: 嘿嘿，他是不是很可爱？

source: Hmph… Are you trying to make fun of me, Dar?!
translation: 哼……你是在取笑我吗，Dar？！

source: It’s always been great to see you share your hobbies with us, Lloyd! This entire project wouldn’t be as fun without them.
translation: 看到你和大家分享爱好一直都很棒，Lloyd！没有这些爱好，整个项目就不会这么有趣。

source: Well, my homoscope sense is telling ya’ll to hurry up and finish so we can eat!
translation: 好吧，我的“同性座”感应告诉我，你们都该赶快干完，好让我们吃饭！

source: Oh right, sorry for the tangent.
translation: 哦，对，抱歉跑题了。

source: I’ve got to hand it to you, Mr. Sirius! These new buildings are looking really cool so far!
translation: 不得不佩服您，Sirius先生！这些新建筑目前看起来真的很酷！

source: It’s a shame that you guys have to see them worn down from the storm…
translation: 可惜你们看到的是它们被暴风雪摧残后的样子……

source: Yeah, I remember it looking a lot more polished before we left.
translation: 是啊，我记得离开前它们精致得多。

source: It’s alright, things happen! We just have to make the best of it!
translation: 没关系，意外难免发生！我们只要尽力而为！

source: Even still, I can already imagine how everything’s going to look!
translation: 即便如此，我已经能想象完工后的样子！

source: I can’t take all the credit, though. Dar is the real MVP in making all my designs a reality.
translation: 不过功劳不能全归我。真正把我的设计变为现实的头号功臣是Dar。

source: Not to mention our amazing construction team who does all the labor!
translation: 更别说承担全部施工劳动的优秀施工队！

source: Lloyd is really modest about these kinds of things.
translation: Lloyd在这种事上真的很谦虚。

source: It was his incredible planning that let us build everything from the ground up.
translation: 正是他出色的规划，让我们能从零开始建造一切。

source: More like tore it all down from being so unprepared for a freak storm…
translation: 更像是因为没准备好应对异常暴风雪，让一切都被摧毁了……

source: See? Modest.
translation: 看吧？很谦虚。

source: Well, it’s not like I designed everything from scratch! I took most of the inspiration and even some plan layouts from the existing structures here!
translation: 这个嘛，我也不是从零设计了一切！大部分灵感甚至一些平面布局，都来自这里现有的建筑！

source: HEY! If you guys would stop chit-chatting so much, you’d shovel a hell of a lot faster!
translation: 喂！你们要是少聊点天，铲雪速度肯定快得多！

source: Oh, that reminds me, I should probably check on the other group too. There was quite a bit more snow over there…
translation: 哦，这提醒我了，也该去看看另一组。那边的积雪多得多……

source: Are you all okay here if I leave for now?
translation: 我暂时离开，你们留在这里没问题吗？

source: No problem, Scoutmaster Yoshi! We’ll make sure Yoichi behaves!
translation: 没问题，Yoshi童子军长！我们会确保Yoichi好好干活！

source: Hey there, guys! How’s everything going here?
translation: 嘿，各位！这里进展如何？

source: Hello, Scoutmaster Yoshi!
translation: 您好，Yoshi童子军长！

source: We’re doing alright, I think…! Not as fast as the other group, but we’re having fun.
translation: 我想进展还不错……！虽然没另一组那么快，但大家很开心。

source: Sir Goro’s been doing most of the heavy lifting. He can work way faster than the rest of us.
translation: Goro先生一直在承担大部分重活。他干活比我们其他人快得多。

source: Haha, we’re mostly just cleaning up after him.
translation: 哈哈，我们主要只是在替他收尾。

source: Now don’t discredit your work so far. All of your efforts count.
translation: 别贬低自己至今的工作。每个人的努力都很重要。

source: I think this is the first time in a while that you’ve done a hands-on activity with the scouts, isn’t it, sir?
translation: 先生，这应该是您很久以来第一次和童子军一起参加动手活动，对吧？

source: Hmm… Outside of the fundraising we did last term… I guess you’re right.
translation: 嗯……除了上期的筹款活动……我想你说得对。

source: I’m actually glad that we get to hang out with you, Sir Goro! We rarely got the chance to do that last year!
translation: 其实我很高兴能和您一起活动，Goro先生！去年我们很少有这种机会！

source: Yeah! He’s not the grumpy-scary camp president anymore!
translation: 是啊！他已经不是那个脾气暴躁、吓人的营地负责人了！

source: Was he really…?
translation: 他以前真是那样吗……？

source: Oh boy, you don’t know the half of it! Almost every scout was afraid of him back then!
translation: 天啊，你根本不了解！当时几乎每个童子军都怕他！

source: Yeah… We all got tongue tied whenever he was in the same room as us…
translation: 是啊……只要和他待在同一个房间，我们所有人都会紧张得说不出话……

source: I-I guess I did feel the same when I first met him… But that changed so quickly as soon as he started to talk.
translation: 我、我初次见到他时好像也有同感……可他一开口，那种感觉很快就消失了。

source: In my stay here so far, I find it kinda hard to imagine him that way… He’s like the calmest and gentlest boss I’ve ever had.
translation: 在这里待到现在，我很难想象他以前是那样……他简直是我遇过最冷静、最温和的上司。

source: They’re telling the truth, Jin. Even the scoutmasters were intimidated by me for the last couple years…
translation: 他们说的是真的，Jin。过去几年里，就连童子军长都被我吓到了……

source: But it’s understandable, sir. You were dealing with a lot of things behind the scenes.
translation: 但这可以理解，先生。当时您在幕后处理很多事情。

source: Yeah… and there were times that we caused trouble too.
translation: 是啊……而且有时我们也会惹麻烦。

source: Even still, it doesn’t excuse my unnecessarily steely demeanor.
translation: 即便如此，也不能成为我态度过度严厉的借口。

source: As the figurehead, I should’ve served as a guiding example by handling everything with patience and compassion.
translation: 作为领头人，我本该以身作则，用耐心和同理心处理一切。

source: But I’m glad everyone, including the scouts, kept an open mind and were able to give me time to change my ways.
translation: 不过我很高兴，包括童子军在内的大家都保持开放心态，愿意给我时间改变。

source: That’s true, sir! We saw how you started changing during our term!
translation: 没错，先生！活动期间，我们看到了您开始改变！

source: And it’s crazy how we can even joke around with you too, sir…
translation: 而且现在甚至能和您开玩笑，真是不可思议，先生……

source: He’s a real fluffy panda now…
translation: 他现在真是一只毛茸茸的熊猫……

source: *ehem* Let’s not get too sentimental, we still have a lot of work to do.
translation: *咳咳* 别太煽情了，我们还有很多工作要做。

source: Hahaha! You’re not really used to the compliments, huh sir?
translation: 哈哈哈！您确实不习惯被人称赞，对吧，先生？

source: C…Cute…
translation: 好……可爱……

source: But Sir Goro has a point… Compared to the other group, we’re lagging behind a bit.
translation: 不过Goro先生说得有道理……和另一组相比，我们有点落后。

source: It’s not fair, we don’t have as many muscles as them!
translation: 这不公平，我们没他们那么多肌肉！

source: Maybe I should’ve taken Aiden’s offer for a fitness routine so I could be more useful…
translation: 也许我应该接受Aiden的健身计划，这样就能更有用了……

source: I just sit in front of my computer all day either doing work or playing games…
translation: 我整天只坐在电脑前，不是在工作，就是在玩游戏……

source: Wait, you play video games too?!
translation: 等等，你也玩电子游戏？！

source: I… I do.
translation: 是……是的。

source: Ooh, ooh! You should add me and maybe we can play together sometime!
translation: 哦哦！你应该加我好友，也许哪天可以一起玩！

source: Haha, that’s mostly all we did at my house.
translation: 哈哈，我们在我家时主要就做这个。

source: I’m a pretty good gamer, if I do say so myself~
translation: 要我自己说，我可是个相当厉害的玩家～

source: I’ve been telling these guys to livestream our game sessions!
translation: 我一直让这些家伙直播我们的游戏过程！

source: But you, Yoichi and Taiga can get so loud and hyper… Keitaro, Natsumi and I can’t even keep up…
translation: 可是你、Yoichi和Taiga会变得又吵又亢奋……Keitaro、Natsumi和我根本跟不上……

source: Well, you could all be really popular with your unique personalities…
translation: 这个嘛，以你们独特的个性，肯定会很受欢迎……

source: What do you usually play, Hyunjin?
translation: 你平时玩什么，Hyunjin？

source: A-Aah… Well… An unhealthy amount of gacha games…
translation: 啊、啊……这个嘛……多到不健康的抽卡游戏……

source: Gacha? What’s that?
translation: 抽卡？那是什么？

source: It’s kinda like that capsule toy vending machine, Keitaro!
translation: 有点像扭蛋机，Keitaro！

source: In this case, you spend some money for a random chance to get stuff you can use to get better in the game!
translation: 在游戏里，你花钱随机获得一些东西，用来让自己变得更强！

source: With real money…?
translation: 用真钱……？

source: Yes. Most game developers nowadays use that as a business model. And it works.
translation: 没错。如今大多数游戏开发者都把它当作商业模式。而且确实有效。

source: The one time I tried playing a gacha game I had to quit – I got super unlucky and was too broke to keep going!
translation: 我有一次尝试玩抽卡游戏，最后只能退坑——运气太差，而且穷得玩不下去！

source: Yeah, having a job means I have access to adult money… and that means I have the freedom to use it on whatever I want…
translation: 是啊，有工作就意味着我有成年人的钱……也意味着可以自由花在任何想要的东西上……

source: It hurts both me and my wallet… But if it’s for my 2-D husbandos, I don’t mind!
translation: 这让我和钱包都很痛苦……但只要是为了我的二次元老公，我不介意！

source: H-Husbandos…?
translation: 老、老公……？

source: I-I mean, characters…! Ahehehe…
translation: 我、我是说角色……！啊嘿嘿嘿……

source: It baffles me how out of touch I am with modern times, that even something like games can be used as a business…
translation: 我竟然如此脱离现代社会，连游戏这种东西也能成为生意，真让我震惊……

source: Yeah, I agree… Could you imagine Camp Buddy as a gacha game?
translation: 是啊，我同意……你能想象伙伴营变成抽卡游戏吗？

source: Looks like time has taken its toll on us, huh, sir?
translation: 看来岁月已经在我们身上留下痕迹，对吧，先生？

source: Scoutmaster Yoshi, you’re not even that old! You shouldn’t be saying things like that.
translation: Yoshi童子军长，您根本没那么老！不该说这种话。

source: Hehe, you really had to leave out Sir Goro from that statement, huh, Keitaro?
translation: 嘿嘿，你非得把Goro先生排除在这句话之外，对吧，Keitaro？

source: A-Ack…!
Hey, watch it, boy.
translation: 嘿，小子，说话小心点。

source: Yikes! Scary Goro’s back!
translation: 糟糕！可怕的Goro又回来了！

source: It’s kinda hot… I mean, it’s cold! It’s getting really cold out here, huh?!
translation: 有点性感……我是说有点冷！外面越来越冷了，对吧？！

source: Either way, working at a summer camp exclusively puts people like Yoshinori and I at a disadvantage.
translation: 不管怎样，只在夏令营工作，让我和Yoshinori这样的人处于劣势。

source: That’s why Jin’s here to bring us up to date!
translation: 所以Jin才来帮我们跟上时代！

source: Yes. We’ll start by having fast Wi-Fi, for sure.
translation: 没错。首先肯定要有高速Wi-Fi。

source: Oh, I have an idea! You should add a lot of computers next term! Or maybe a few gaming consoles… or even better, VR!
translation: 哦，我有个主意！下期应该增加很多电脑！或者放几台游戏机……更棒的是VR！

source: Hiro… I don’t think that’s a good idea…
translation: Hiro……我觉得这不是个好主意……

source: Why noooot? That could be a really cool camp activity! I can already see it… We’ll call it the Camp Budd-E-Sportsfest!
translation: 为什——么？那可以成为超酷的营地活动！我已经想到了……就叫“伙伴营电子竞技节”！

source: That was bad.
translation: 这个名字很烂。

source: Ahehe…
translation: 啊嘿嘿……

source: {i}Everyone continued to work hard while we caught up, and after a few hours, we could really start to see the progress!{/i}
translation: {i}大家一边叙旧，一边继续努力工作；几个小时后，进展终于变得明显！{/i}

source: Hey, everyone! Why don’t we take a break?
translation: 嘿，各位！我们休息一下怎么样？

source: Whew… There’s still so much left even after all that shoveling.
translation: 呼……铲了这么久，居然还剩这么多。

source: I can’t imagine how the scoutmasters were planning to do it by themselves…
translation: 真无法想象童子军长们原本打算怎么独自完成……

source: Yeah, by the looks of things I think we’ll need another day to finish up.
translation: 是啊，照目前情况看，我想还需要一天才能完成。

source: Either way, you scouts helping out is already a huge boost! We managed to clear out a huge chunk of ice and snow in a short time!
translation: 不管怎样，有你们这些童子军帮忙，已经大大加快了进度！短时间内就清理了大片冰雪！

source: Yes, we’re in a much better state than yesterday.
translation: 没错，情况比昨天好得多。

source: We’d be a lot faster if we had a snowplow, though.
translation: 不过要是有扫雪机，速度会快得多。

source: But I guess it doesn’t make sense for Camp Buddy to have something like that on hand.
translation: 但伙伴营平时备着那种机器，好像也不合理。

source: Usually the local city hall sends their assistance, and I’ve been in touch with them since yesterday. Unfortunately, they’re still occupied clearing public roads.
translation: 通常当地市政厅会派人协助，我从昨天起就一直与他们联系。遗憾的是，他们还在忙着清理公共道路。

source: For now, we’ll have to make do.
translation: 目前只能先将就。

source: If we didn’t have to clean up after Wolfboy tossing snow around, we could’ve been done by now!
translation: 要不是得替Wolfboy收拾乱扔的雪，我们现在已经干完了！

source: Gimme a break! I still shoveled a hell of a lot more snow than you did, you twiggy Torch-head!
translation: 饶了我吧！我铲的雪还是比你多得多，你这个细竹竿Torch-head！

source: Maybe we should bring out Ms. Yuri to scare Yoichi into doing more work!
translation: 也许该把Yuri小姐叫出来，吓唬Yoichi多干点活！

source: Oh yeah… We still haven’t seen Ms. Yuri.
translation: 哦，对……我们还没见到Yuri小姐。

source: And I’m curious… Who is she busy taking care of?
translation: 而且我很好奇……她正忙着照顾谁？

source: Ah, Yuri’s watching over Emilia, our inspector… sort of.
translation: 啊，Yuri在照顾Emilia，我们的检查员……算是吧。

source: Huh? What happened with her? Is she sick?
translation: 嗯？她怎么了？生病了吗？

source: Yeah. But don’t worry, she’s doing a lot better now and just needs to continue resting!
translation: 是的。不过别担心，她现在已经好多了，只需要继续休息！

source: Yuri’s making sure of that while we’re out here!
translation: 我们在外面干活时，Yuri会确保她好好休息！

source: Oh, they must be close friends then. I bet we’ll like her too!
translation: 哦，那她们一定是亲密朋友。我敢说我们也会喜欢她！

source: You’re way off, Twinkerbell! She’s been a prick ever since she got here a couple months ago!
translation: 你错得离谱，Twinkerbell！她几个月前来到这里后，就一直是个混蛋！

source: Yoichi! That’s not a nice way to introduce someone!
translation: Yoichi！不能这样介绍别人！

source: For once, I agree with this hairball. I got nothing but bad vibes from her. But then I could be wrong.
translation: 这一次我同意这个毛球。她只让我感觉不妙。不过也可能是我错了。

source: Oooh… Tea…
translation: 哦……有瓜吃……

source: Hmm… We won’t deny that she can be strict and demanding when it comes to doing her job. But you can’t judge a book by its cover.
translation: 嗯……我们不否认她工作时可能严格又苛刻。但不能以貌取人。

source: Yes. You never know what people are going through that makes them act a certain way.
translation: 没错。你永远不知道别人经历了什么，才会以某种方式行事。

source: We learned that during our trip…
translation: 这次旅行让我们明白了这一点……

source: Meh, I don’t get it.
translation: 切，我不明白。

source: Oh, I do! It’s similar with Sir Goro, right? He was very ‘strict’ before, too! Now he’s all nice and friendly!
translation: 哦，我明白！和Goro先生很像，对吧？他以前也非常“严格”！现在却亲切又友好！

source: *sigh* Why am I in the spotlight again…?
translation: *叹气* 为什么焦点又落在我身上……？

source: Psh! Why go further when you have Taiga right here? He was a total douche back then too, right?
translation: 切！何必舍近求远，Taiga不就在这里吗？他以前也是个十足的混蛋，对吧？

source: H-Hey!
translation: 喂、喂！

source: Either way, I can’t wait to meet her too! We’re already friends with Mr. Lloyd, Darius and Hyunjin!
translation: 不管怎样，我也等不及见她了！我们已经和Lloyd先生、Darius还有Hyunjin成了朋友！

source: There you go again Keitaro, making everyone your best friend!
translation: Keitaro，你又来了，把每个人都当成最好的朋友！

source: Lunchtime, everyone! I made a nice pot of chili, some corn muffins, and a warm pudding for dessert!
translation: 午饭时间到了，各位！我做了一大锅辣味炖肉、一些玉米松饼，还有热布丁当甜点！

source: It’s all in the mess hall! Get it while it’s hot!
translation: 全都放在食堂！趁热来吃！

source: Alright! I’m starving! Dibs on everything!
translation: 太好了！我快饿死了！所有东西都归我！

source: Hey! Leave some for me!
translation: 喂！给我留一点！

source: No way I’m gonna miss out on the food!
translation: 我绝不会错过这些食物！

source: H-Hey…! Everyone else has to eat too!
translation: 喂、喂……！其他人也得吃！

source: Hehe, there’s no stopping them, Natsumi…
translation: 嘿嘿，拦不住他们的，Natsumi……

source: I guess we should go and join them.
translation: 看来我们也该过去了。

source: Wah! You’re the best, Aiden! Steaming hot food is perfect for this kind of weather!
translation: 哇！你最棒了，Aiden！这种天气最适合热气腾腾的食物！

source: Yum.
translation: 好吃。

source: I hope you guys don’t mind if I join the scouts… I’m actually really starving now.
translation: 希望大家不介意我和童子军一起吃……其实我现在真的很饿。

source: *sigh* I really missed having the scouts around! They’re always so excited for anything I cook.
translation: *叹气* 我真的很想念童子军在身边的日子！无论我做什么，他们总是这么兴奋。

source: I agree. Their presence here today really boosted our morale.
translation: 我同意。他们今天到来，确实大大鼓舞了士气。

source: I’m not going to lie, I was feeling rather stressed out after dealing with issues one after another since we left the hotel.
translation: 说实话，自从离开酒店后接连处理各种问题，我确实感到压力很大。

source: Thank you for taking the initiative and finding a solution to our issues, Yoshinori.
translation: 谢谢你主动为我们的问题寻找解决办法，Yoshinori。

source: Yoshi is still the same model scout, always prepared for anything!
translation: Yoshi还是那个模范童子军，永远为一切做好准备！

source: Ahehe, I’m just glad it turned into such a great day for everyone.
translation: 啊嘿嘿，我只是很高兴今天最终变得如此美好。

source: This actually leaves me a little bit of time to give an update to Mr. Clermont.
translation: 这样我正好有一点时间向Clermont先生汇报进展。

source: He should be a bit relieved to hear that we got additional help today.
translation: 听说今天有额外人手，他应该会稍微放心。

source: Oh yeah… you’re the one doing that now since Emilia is tapped out.
translation: 哦，对……Emilia无法工作，现在由你来负责汇报。

source: I should check on her today to see if she’s feeling any better.
translation: 今天我该去看看她，确认身体有没有好转。

source: Good idea! I’m supposed to hand over her lunch, but you can do that!
translation: 好主意！本来应该由我给她送午餐，不过可以交给你！

source: I’ll take over for you clearing out the snow! I gotta make up for my time in the kitchen, after all.
translation: 我替你去清雪！毕竟得把待在厨房的时间补回来。

source: A-Ahh… Sure thing, Aiden! Thanks a lot!
translation: 啊、啊……好啊，Aiden！非常感谢！

source: See you later then, Yoshinori.
translation: 那待会儿见，Yoshinori。

source: … And whenever I try and give someone criticism, I always try and do it gently, so that they don’t beat themselves up too much.
translation: ……而且每当我要批评某人时，总会尽量说得温和，免得对方过度责怪自己。

source: R-Right…
translation: 对、对……

source: *sigh* I guess I really thought people preferred the straightforwardness…
translation: *叹气* 我真的以为大家更喜欢直截了当……

source: Hihi, well it DOES have it’s time and place, but maybe not all the time~
translation: 嘻嘻，这种方式确实有适用的场合，但也许不能一直这样～

source: Hello, you two! I brought your lunch, Emilia.
translation: 你们好！Emilia，我把午饭带来了。

source: I hope I’m not interrupting anything.
translation: 希望没有打扰你们。

source: Not at all, I was just giving Emilia some advice.
translation: 完全没有，我只是在给Emilia一些建议。

source: Whoa… I’m really surprised to hear that, Yuri.
translation: 哇……听你这么说，我真的很惊讶，Yuri。

source: Well, she asked for it. And I didn’t have much of a choice, since I AM the camp counselor you know.
translation: 这个嘛，是她主动问的。而且我也没多少选择，毕竟我就是营地辅导员。

source: I-I could have handled myself just fine, thank you very much…!
translation: 我、我自己完全能处理好，真是谢谢你了……！

source: Ah-ah-ah~, what did I tell you about relying on other people? It’s good to have a support system... and you couldn’t even find your meds a while ago!
translation: 啊啊啊～我怎么说来着，要学会依靠别人？有人支持是好事……而且你刚才连自己的药都找不到！

source: Just so you know, I’m feeling a lot stronger already. I’d say I’m almost back to normal.
translation: 告诉你，我已经感觉强壮多了。可以说快恢复正常了。

source: Well, I’m glad that you’re recovering just fine, Emilia!
translation: 好吧，很高兴你恢复得很顺利，Emilia！

source: Yuri here has been listening to me ramble all day.
translation: Yuri一整天都在听我絮絮叨叨。

source: I hate to admit it, but she made really great points that made me realize the mistakes I made about how I come across to everyone.
translation: 虽然不愿承认，但她提出了非常好的观点，让我意识到自己在与人相处方式上的错误。

source: She’s an excellent counselor, I must say.
translation: 我必须说，她是个出色的辅导员。

source: Well, that is my job here after all~ And a counselor can only help if the person is willing to meet them halfway!
translation: 这个嘛，那毕竟是我的工作～而且只有当事人愿意迈出一步，辅导员才能帮上忙！

source: You’ve been really open with me today, and it was thanks to that I was able to find some answers for you.
translation: 你今天对我非常坦诚，正因为如此，我才能为你找到一些答案。

source: Having someone to tell all my thoughts to is still new to me. It really does help.
translation: 能把所有想法告诉别人，对我来说仍很陌生。但这真的很有帮助。

source: Wow, I never thought I’d hear that from you both!
translation: 哇，真没想到会从你们两个口中听到这种话！

source: Maybe you’ll end up as close friends after all, haha!
translation: 也许你们最后真的会成为亲密朋友，哈哈！

source: Hmph, I doubt it! There’s no way I could deal with her strange hobbies and manic episodes!
translation: 哼，我很怀疑！我不可能忍受她那些奇怪爱好和躁狂发作！

source: Hey! It’s a lot better than being snobby and pretending to be rich!
translation: 喂！这可比势利又装有钱好多了！

source: Hngh!
translation: 嗯哼！

source: Ahehe… Maybe I spoke too soon.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……也许我说得太早了。

source: Anyway, you guys must be super busy with groundwork, huh Yoshi? I’ve barely seen anyone all day long!
translation: 总之，你们一定都在忙工地，对吧Yoshi？我一整天几乎没见到任何人！

source: Oh, the scouts came by to help us shovel! I called Yoichi and Taiga last night, and the whole gang came along!
translation: 哦，童子军来帮我们铲雪了！昨晚我给Yoichi和Taiga打了电话，结果所有人都来了！

source: WHAT?! And nobody told me?!
translation: 什么？！居然没人告诉我？！

source: I gotta get out there – your turn now, Yoshi!
translation: 我得出去见他们——现在轮到你了，Yoshi！

source: W-Wait, Yuri—
translation: 等、等等，Yuri——

source: Ugh… It’s about time she left.
translation: 呃……她总算走了。

source: Hehe, I’m really glad you two are getting along a little better now, Emilia…
translation: 嘿嘿，我真的很高兴你们两个现在相处得好一些了，Emilia……

source: *sigh* Barely… I’m just trying my best to keep my cool.
translation: *叹气* 勉强而已……我只是在尽力保持冷静。

source: D-Don’t get me wrong, I am grateful for all her help.
translation: 别、别误会，我确实很感谢她的帮助。

source: I was discussing with Yuri about moving forward… and that includes my position here at the camp.
translation: 我刚才和Yuri讨论今后的打算……其中也包括我在营地的职位。

source: I really appreciate that you all gave me a bit of time to calm down and stay here until I recover…
translation: 真的很感谢大家给我时间冷静，还允许我留在这里恢复……

source: But I found out from Yuri that none of you told Mr. Clermont the issue about my credentials…
translation: 但我从Yuri那里得知，你们没有把资历问题告诉Clermont先生……

source: Well, he was informed you weren’t feeling well, but we left the rest out for now.
translation: 这个嘛，我们告诉他你身体不适，但暂时省略了其他事情。

source: After all, we still have a situation on the site to deal with.
translation: 毕竟工地上的问题还需要处理。

source: On that note, I was hoping to report my own mistakes to Mr. Clermont directly.
translation: 说到这里，我希望亲自向Clermont先生报告自己的错误。

source: I’m well aware of the severity of the error I made, which is why I need to be terminated from my position so that I don’t negatively affect the project further.
translation: 我很清楚所犯错误的严重性，所以必须被解除职务，免得进一步对项目造成负面影响。

source: But you don’t have to do that right now. We have everything under control with the work so far.
translation: 但你不必现在就做。目前工作的一切都在控制之中。

source: It’s just… I need to face the consequences of my actions.
translation: 只是……我需要面对自己行为的后果。

source: I don’t want to live a lie anymore…
translation: 我不想再活在谎言中……

source: I understand, Emilia.
translation: 我明白，Emilia。

source: {i}After our serious talk, Emilia and I chatted a little bit more light-heartedly about the scouts coming back and when she’d get to meet them.{/i}
translation: {i}严肃交谈之后，我和Emilia又轻松地聊了聊童子军回来，以及她什么时候能见到他们。{/i}

source: *sigh* The roadway is still covered in snow…
translation: *叹气* 道路仍被积雪覆盖……

source: At this rate, I don’t think the city would be able to help us anytime soon.
translation: 照这样下去，我觉得市政府短时间内无法来帮助我们。

source: Huh…? Who’s—
Mr. Clermont?!
translation: Clermont先生？！

source: Ah, Mr. Nomoru! Pardon my sudden visit, but I’ve brought some assistance!
translation: 啊，Nomoru先生！请原谅我突然来访，不过我带来了些援助！

source: Wh-What do you mean, sir?
translation: 您、您是什么意思，先生？

source: Well, after your progress report yesterday, I had to see for myself how much damage the storm had done.
translation: 这个嘛，看了你昨天的进度报告后，我必须亲眼看看暴风雪造成了多大损失。

source: That, and Ms. Komarova’s illness had me quite concerned.
translation: 另外，Komarova小姐生病也让我非常担心。

source: I thought it would be best to head over straight away and assess what could be done, as well as bring some snow blowers to assist with your cleanup.
translation: 我觉得最好马上赶来，评估能做些什么，同时带几台吹雪机协助清理。

source: They’re all brand new and belong to Camp Buddy now!
translation: 全都是崭新的，现在归伙伴营所有！

source: Once again, this is too much, sir… You’ve already given so much to the camp, and now you’re taking time to personally visit.
translation: 先生，您又做得太多了……已经为营地付出那么多，现在还抽时间亲自来访。

source: Nonsense. Think of it as part of the sponsorship.
translation: 别胡说。把它当作赞助的一部分。

source: And don’t worry, I’m on leave at the moment! I thought it would be a nice change of scenery to see Camp Buddy again. I’m quite fond of it, now~
translation: 而且别担心，我目前正在休假！我想再来看看伙伴营，换换环境也不错。现在我很喜欢这里～

source: Oh! And if you’d like, I can get out a bit of elbow grease and help you clear the snow myself too, haha!
translation: 哦！如果你们愿意，我也可以亲自动手，帮忙清雪，哈哈！

source: That’s not necessary, sir! I do think with the combination of the machines that you brought and the extra help from the scouts, we may be able to finish everything today!
translation: 不用了，先生！有您带来的机器，再加上童子军的额外帮助，我觉得今天就能完成一切！

source: Hahaha! I’m not as fragile as I look, you know! I used to be quite tough back in my more youthful days!
translation: 哈哈哈！我可没有看起来那么脆弱！年轻时我也相当强壮！

source: But very well, I’ll leave the work to your team!
translation: 不过好吧，工作就交给你们团队！

source: Now, should we get these snow blowers inside? I’m eager to see how quickly they can knock those piles away!
translation: 现在要把这些吹雪机送进去吗？我很想看看它们能多快清掉那些雪堆！

source: I’d also love to meet the scouts again! Is Mr. Nagame over there?
translation: 我也很想再见见童子军！那边的是Nagame先生吗？

source: W-Wait, Mr. Clermont, please let me carry that!
translation: 等、等等，Clermont先生，请让我来搬！

source: Whooooo!!!
Screw digging, this is way more fun!
translation: 去他的铲雪，这个好玩多了！

source: Yoichi! You’re making a huge mess! Stop playing around!
translation: Yoichi！你搞得一团糟！别玩了！

source: Shut up, Mr. Perfect!
translation: 闭嘴，Mr. Perfect！

source: Aww… Look at the scouts! They’re really enjoying themselves!
translation: 哎呀……看看童子军！他们真的玩得很开心！

source: The way they’re using the snowblowers makes it look like it’s not even a chore anymore.
translation: 看他们使用吹雪机的样子，这简直已经不算杂活了。

source: I kinda want to try one as well…
translation: 我也有点想试试……

source: These snowblowers are the best! We only need to shovel the bigger piles, and then just blow the rest!
translation: 这些吹雪机太棒了！只需要铲开大雪堆，再吹走剩下的雪！

source: We can clear the entire site and start rebuilding by tomorrow at this rate.
translation: 照这个速度，今天能清理完整个工地，明天就能开始重建。

source: Haha! I’m glad they helped!
translation: 哈哈！很高兴它们帮上了忙！

source: I don’t know how to thank you, Mr. Clermont. You’ve done so much for us over these past few months.
translation: 真不知道该如何感谢您，Clermont先生。过去几个月里，您为我们做了太多。

source: First it was the sponsorship, then our vacation, and now you’re taking time out of your busy life to help us with even minor inconveniences.
translation: 先是赞助，然后是度假，现在连这种小麻烦，您都从繁忙生活中抽出时间来帮忙。

source: Hihi, you’re starting to fanboy again, Dad!
translation: 嘻嘻，爸爸，你又开始像小迷弟一样了！

source: *ehem* I’m just being grateful!
translation: *咳咳* 我只是在表达感激！

source: Hahaha! Don’t mention it! I feel indebted to you all as well, you know.
translation: 哈哈哈！不用客气！我也觉得欠大家很多，知道吗。

source: You were able to mold my son, Felix, to be quite the active and friendly person. And you helped me out with my business!
translation: 你们把我的儿子Felix培养成了活跃友善的人，还帮助了我的生意！

source: I wouldn’t have minded having an experience like Camp Buddy growing up too, haha!
translation: 我成长时要是也能体验伙伴营这样的生活，一定不会介意，哈哈！

source: Anyway, that’s enough reminiscing for now! If you don’t mind, I’d like to go and see Ms. Komarova to check on her condition.
translation: 总之，先不怀旧了！如果方便，我想去看看Komarova小姐，确认她的情况。

source: I won’t take up too much of her time, I just want to wish her well.
translation: 我不会占用她太多时间，只想祝她早日康复。

source: Alright, please follow me.
translation: 好的，请跟我来。

source: Oh no… Is Ms. Emilia gonna get in trouble…?
translation: 哦不……Emilia小姐会遇到麻烦吗……？

source: That’s what I’m thinking as well.
translation: 我也在担心这一点。

source: But none of us told Mr. Clermont yet, right?
translation: 可我们还没人告诉Clermont先生，对吧？

source: Well… Emilia was clear today about wanting to come clean. I just didn’t expect it to be this early.
translation: 这个嘛……Emilia今天明确说想坦白一切。只是没想到会这么早。

source: It’ll be fine, Yoshi and Gramps are gonna be there with her!
translation: 不会有事，Yoshi和Gramps都会陪着她！

source: Hmm, it seems like there’s quite the commotion outside. I wonder if something happened.
translation: 嗯，外面似乎很热闹。不知道发生了什么。

source: Hello! Sorry for the surprise visit, but I wanted to check on our patient!
translation: 你好！抱歉突然来访，我想看看我们的病人！

source: Mr. Clermont came here after my report this morning… He brought in some equipment to help clear the grounds.
translation: Clermont先生看过我今早的报告后就来了……还带了一些设备帮忙清理场地。

source: Oh… So that’s what I’ve been hearing outside.
translation: 哦……原来外面的声音是这么回事。

source: Haha, it’s been a while since I’ve been to Camp Buddy and I wanted to have a little tour, and Mr. Nomoru was nice enough to give me a very good one.
translation: 哈哈，我已经有一阵子没来伙伴营，想四处参观一下；Nomoru先生很热情地带我好好看了一圈。

source: I also wanted to check myself once I heard one of our important staff members was ill!
translation: 听说一名重要员工生病后，我也想亲自来查看！

source: How are you, Emilia?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，Emilia？

source: I-I’m doing fine, sir.
translation: 我、我很好，先生。

source: But I have something very important I need to discuss with you.
translation: 但有一件非常重要的事需要和您谈。

source: Emilia—
translation: Emilia——

source: It’s alright, Yoshi. It’s about time Mr. Clermont hears the truth.
translation: 没关系，Yoshi。是时候让Clermont先生知道真相了。

source: I’m quite confused. What do you mean, Ms. Komarova?
translation: 我很困惑。您是什么意思，Komarova小姐？

source: I regret to inform you my professional identity has been far from the truth, sir.
translation: 很遗憾地告诉您，我的职业身份远非事实，先生。

source: To start with, I falsified my credentials to get the job as an inspector.
translation: 首先，我伪造了资历，才得到检查员的工作。

source: In addition, I let my own personal issues with the other staff members here get in the way of progress, hindering the project multiple times.
translation: 此外，我让自己与其他员工的私人矛盾妨碍工作，多次阻碍项目进展。

source: I am not qualified for the position and will be resigning effective immediately.
translation: 我不具备担任这个职位的资格，将立即辞职。

source: I… am lost for words… I certainly wasn’t expecting this from you, Ms. Komarova.
translation: 我……一时无言以对……确实没想到会从您口中听到这些，Komarova小姐。

source: Did you know about this, Mr. Nomoru? Mr. Nagira?
translation: Nomoru先生、Nagira先生，你们知道这件事吗？

source: W-We only learned recently, sir. During our stay at the hotel.
translation: 我、我们最近才知道，先生。是在酒店住宿期间。

source: Our intent was to let Ms. Komarova recover, then inform you.
translation: 我们本打算先让Komarova小姐恢复健康，再通知您。

source: *sigh* To be honest, I didn’t come here just to help with the storm.
translation: *叹气* 说实话，我来这里并不只是为了帮助处理暴风雪。

source: I also wished to see if you all had been able to work out the issues I saw a week ago during our meeting.
translation: 我也想看看，各位是否解决了一周前会议上暴露的问题。

source: At first, I was impressed and happy that everything seemed to have worked out well… I actually came here to congratulate you personally.
translation: 起初看到一切似乎顺利解决，我非常欣慰和高兴……其实我本来是亲自来祝贺大家的。

source: As unfortunate as this news is, I must commend you for your honesty, Ms. Komarova.
translation: 尽管这个消息令人遗憾，但我必须赞扬您的坦诚，Komarova小姐。

source: Regardless, I have to accept your resignation and not allow you to represent my company any longer.
translation: 无论如何，我必须接受您的辞职，不能再允许您代表我的公司。

source: I understand…
translation: 我明白……

source: Mr. Nomoru, allow me to sincerely apologize for this unacceptable oversight on behalf of the entire project.
translation: Nomoru先生，请允许我代表整个项目，为这次不可接受的疏忽诚恳道歉。

source: I personally prioritized those who had a familiarity with the camp during the application process.
translation: 申请过程中，我个人优先考虑了熟悉营地的人选。

source: I understand now all the concerns your team expressed, and quite frankly this could have been avoided if the screening had been done properly.
translation: 现在我理解贵团队提出的所有担忧；坦白说，如果当初正确进行审查，这一切本可避免。

source: We weren’t aware of this matter either until recently like I said. You can at least be relieved to know that we managed to fix it amongst ourselves.
translation: 就像我说的，我们也是最近才知道。至少您可以放心，我们已经自行解决了矛盾。

source: But Mr. Clermont, if I may?
translation: 不过Clermont先生，能允许我说一句吗？

source: Yes?
translation: 请说？

source: I understand your decision to remove Ms.  Komarova as our inspector.
translation: 我理解您解除Komarova小姐检查员职务的决定。

source: However, with your permission, I’d like to offer her a position here at Camp Buddy.
translation: 不过在您允许的情况下，我想为她提供伙伴营里的另一个职位。

source: Wh-What?!
translation: 什、什么？！

source: May I ask why you’re requesting this?
translation: 可以问问您为何提出这个请求吗？

source: I’ve been speaking with the rest of the staff and gathering their thoughts on the matter.
translation: 我已经与其他员工谈过，收集了大家对此事的意见。

source: Yoshinori, if you wouldn’t mind explaining?
translation: Yoshinori，如果不介意，能由你来解释吗？

source: A-Ah…! Yes, sir.
translation: 啊、啊……！是，先生。

source: I know that we all started off on the wrong foot with Emilia, but we moved past our differences.
translation: 我知道大家与Emilia一开始相处得并不好，但已经跨过了分歧。

source: We talked about it, and we all want her to continue working with us.
translation: 我们讨论过了，所有人都希望她继续和我们一起工作。

source: Even though she may have forged her credentials, her work ethic and commitment to the project are very much real.
translation: 虽然她伪造了资历，但她的职业态度和对项目的投入都是真实的。

source: We believe it would be in the best interests of both Emilia and Camp Buddy to have her stay.
translation: 我们相信，让她留下符合Emilia和伙伴营双方的最佳利益。

source: You all never cease to amaze me. One surprise after another, huh?
translation: 你们总能让我惊叹。真是一个惊喜接着一个，对吧？

source: If you all feel so strongly about it, then I’m in no place to disagree. You know what’s best for your camp.
translation: 既然大家都如此坚持，我也没有理由反对。你们最清楚什么对营地最好。

source: Mr. Nomoru will be my direct contact in place of Ms. Komarova, but I’m sure you have something planned for her.
translation: Nomoru先生将取代Komarova小姐，成为我的直接联系人；不过我相信你们已经为她另有安排。

source: Ms. Komarova herself is free to accept or decline the offer – it’s up to her.
translation: Komarova小姐本人可以自由接受或拒绝邀请——由她决定。

source: This is all so… overwhelming…
translation: 这一切实在……让我不知所措……

source: Everyone is going out of their way to help me… even after everything I’ve done…
translation: 所有人都在不遗余力地帮助我……即使我做了那么多错事……

source: The people I mistreated are the ones who saved me from what I thought was inevitable…
translation: 正是那些曾被我伤害的人，把我从自以为无可避免的结局中救了出来……

source: We’ve all gone through our own hardships, making mistakes along the way.
translation: 我们都经历过各自的艰难，也都一路犯过错误。

source: It’s about how you change from here on out.
translation: 重要的是从今以后如何改变。

source: What I do know is all of us would be glad to work further with you, but now that choice is entirely up to you.
translation: 我知道大家都愿意继续与你共事，但现在选择权完全在你。

source: I-I’m more than happy to accept and I’m nothing but grateful…!
translation: 我、我非常愿意接受，心中只有感激……！

source: Well, it seems that everyone has mutual feelings here after all!
translation: 好吧，看来大家最终还是心意相通！

source: You’ve all resolved the issues I was worried about, even if they weren’t in ways I expected!
translation: 你们已经解决了我担忧的问题，虽然方式与预想完全不同！

source: I think what I’ve witnessed here is a testament to the true Camp Buddy spirit!
translation: 我认为今天见证的一切，正是真正伙伴营精神的证明！

source: I am more honored than ever to be your sponsor.
translation: 能够成为你们的赞助商，我比以往任何时候都更感荣幸。

source: Yuri, I told you not to barge in… they aren’t done yet…!
translation: Yuri，我说过别闯进来……他们还没谈完……！

source: Emilia! I’m so glad you accepted the offer!
translation: Emilia！真高兴你接受了邀请！

source: Welcome to the project, officially.
translation: 正式欢迎加入项目。

source: I’m glad it all worked out in the end!
translation: 很高兴最终一切顺利解决！

source: Everyone…
translation: 大家……

source: We were so nervous when you confessed, but it was the right thing to do!
translation: 你坦白时我们紧张极了，但那是正确的选择！

source: W-Were you all really eavesdropping?
translation: 你、你们真的一直在偷听？

source: S-Sort of… But we didn’t mean to…
translation: 算、算是吧……但我们不是故意的……

source: It’s alright, everyone, we’re about finished. What brings you all here anyway?
translation: 没关系，各位，我们差不多谈完了。不过你们来这里做什么？

source: With the help of the scouts and the machines, we were able to finish clearing the site today!
translation: 有童子军和机器的帮助，我们今天就清理完了工地！

source: We can start fixing the actual damage tomorrow.
translation: 明天可以开始修复实际损坏。

source: Wow! Everything’s cleared out? That’s amazing! I guess we’re officially back on track then!
translation: 哇！全都清理完了？太棒了！看来我们正式重回正轨！

source: Good job, everyone!
translation: 干得好，各位！

source: Soooo… We actually have one more surprise for everyone…
translation: 所以——……其实我们还为大家准备了一个惊喜……

source: Since we achieved this goal and everybody is here, along with Mr. Clermont and the scouts, I’ve decided to throw us a party!
translation: 既然实现了这个目标，而且大家、Clermont先生和童子军都在，我决定举办一场派对！

source: Yuri… We literally just came back from a vacation… Is this really necessary…?
translation: Yuri……我们明明才刚度假回来……真的有必要吗……？

source: Come onnn!!! We rarely have this many people around during the winter season! And besides, the holidays are just around the corner!
translation: 拜托——！！！冬季很少有这么多人聚在这里！而且节日马上就要到了！

source: We’ve already decorated and prepared everything!
translation: 我们已经装饰并准备好了一切！

source: I guess, we don’t really have a choice, sir…
translation: 看来我们确实没有选择，先生……

source: Hehe, she’s been pushing us to finish all day so we’d have time for it.
translation: 嘿嘿，她一整天都在催大家完工，就是为了腾出时间。

source: Yeah… My fingers feel frozen from all the time outside today…
translation: 是啊……今天在外面待了那么久，手指都像冻住了……

source: Mr. Clermont, I hope you’ll stay as well! It’s the least we could do after all your help today!
translation: Clermont先生，希望您也能留下！您今天帮了这么多忙，这至少是我们该做的！

source: I don’t see why not? I’d love to join the celebration!
translation: 为什么不呢？我很乐意参加庆祝！

source: Alright! The party is on! Come on, there’s plenty of food in the mess hall!
translation: 好！派对开始！快来，食堂里有很多食物！

source: Awesome! I’m so hungry from all that work today! I can’t wait!
translation: 太棒了！今天干了这么多活，我饿坏了！等不及了！

source: Let’s get wild.
translation: 尽情狂欢吧。

source: I’ll go get us some liquor!
translation: 我去给大家拿些酒！

source: You should join us, Emilia! The scouts have been dying to meet you!
translation: 你也应该参加，Emilia！童子军都迫不及待想见你！

source: Oh yeah, let me introduce you! You’re going to love them!
translation: 哦，对，让我来介绍你！你一定会喜欢他们！

source: W-Wait… before we leave… I really want to take this opportunity to properly thank you both…
translation: 等、等等……离开前……我真的想借这个机会正式感谢你们两个……

source: This is more than I could have ever hoped for, and I want to make sure the trust everyone placed in me is worth it.
translation: 这一切远超我的期望，我想确保自己配得上大家给予的信任。

source: That’s the spirit, Emilia! You’re speaking like a true buddy now!
translation: 就是这种精神，Emilia！你现在说话真像一个真正的伙伴！

source: Come on, that’s enough cheese, you two! We’re having fun tonight!
translation: 拜托，你们两个别再肉麻了！今晚要好好玩！

source: Now, Yoshi, go and fetch the scouts and bring them to the mess hall!
translation: 好了，Yoshi，去把童子军叫来，带他们到食堂！

source: I can’t wait for them to see what I’ve done!!
translation: 等不及让他们看看我的杰作了！！

source: Alright, Emilia! You’re coming with me! I have to put you into something ‘special’!
translation: 好了，Emilia！跟我来！我得让你穿上一套“特别”的衣服！

source: Wahhh… All the lights and decorations are so pretty! They make the mess hall look so festive!
translation: 哇……所有灯光和装饰都好漂亮！让食堂充满了节日气氛！

source: Wow… Yuri really went all out again with this event, huh…?
translation: 哇……Yuri为了这次活动又使出了浑身解数，对吧……？

source: Welcome to our wonderful Kris-My-Ass spectacular party!
translation: 欢迎来到精彩绝伦的“亲我屁股节”派对！

source: Y-Yuri! What are you wearing!?
translation: 尤、Yuri！你穿的是什么？！

source: What? It’s just a festive get-up to get in the mood! Don’t you like it?
translation: 怎么？只是为了进入气氛而穿的节日服装！不喜欢吗？

source: I… Uhh… Yeah?
translation: 我……呃……喜欢？

source: We’re having a holiday party, so we might as well play the part!
translation: 既然要举办节日派对，就该把角色扮演到底！

source: The holiday’s still a couple weeks away! Your calendar’s way off again, crazy lady!
translation: 离节日还有好几个星期！你的日历又错得离谱了，疯女人！

source: A long day of hard work calls for a celebration!
translation: 辛苦工作一整天，就该好好庆祝！

source: Here, I even have party hats for everyone!
translation: 来，我甚至给每个人准备了派对帽！

source: Look how cute! Everyone matches the theme now!
translation: 看看多可爱！现在所有人都符合主题了！

source: Don’t be such a party pooper, Wolfboy! Costumes are always fun!
translation: 别这么扫兴，Wolfboy！穿戏服总是很好玩！

source: I actually would’ve picked some for you guys, had I known you were coming.
translation: 要是早知道你们会来，其实也会替你们选几套。

source: But I did get some lovely outfits for your scoutmasters, including you, Yoshi! What I’m wearing is just a taste of what’s to come!
translation: 不过我确实为你们的童子军长准备了漂亮服装，其中也包括你，Yoshi！我身上这套只是接下来的预告！

source: Well, I think you look really pretty, Ms. Yuri!
translation: 这个嘛，我觉得您看起来真的很漂亮，Yuri小姐！

source: Pretty creepy!
translation: 是很吓人才对！

source: Shush, Wolfboy!
translation: 闭嘴，Wolfboy！

source: I guess I do feel a lot more festive now wearing this~
translation: 穿上这个后，我确实更有节日气氛了～

source: Haha, this really reminds me of the costume party during camp. It feels nostalgic!
translation: 哈哈，这真让我想起营地活动期间的化装舞会。好怀念！

source: Keitaro, that was literally this year… you’re making it sound like it’s been a long time…
translation: Keitaro，那明明就是今年的事……你说得像已经过去很久……

source: Well, time moves slower when I’m not seeing you guys, after all!
translation: 这个嘛，见不到大家时，时间毕竟过得更慢！

source: Hehe, leave it to Ms. Yuri to make any party a lot more colorful!
translation: 嘿嘿，任何派对交给Yuri小姐，都会变得更加多彩！

source: Anyway, make yourselves comfortable! You guys can start digging into the food Aiden prepared!
translation: 总之，大家随意一点！可以开始享用Aiden准备的食物了！

source: Finally! Some good food after days of trash!
translation: 终于！吃了好几天垃圾，总算有好东西了！

source: Hey, fast food isn’t trash! That stuff is my favorite.
translation: 喂，快餐才不是垃圾！那可是我的最爱。

source: Stupid Torch-head didn’t even try to cook for us!
translation: 笨蛋Torch-head甚至没试着给我们做饭！

source: I still need ingredients, you stupid Wolfboy! I didn’t expect us to be locked up inside for so long.
translation: 做饭也需要食材，你这个笨Wolfboy！我没想到大家会被困在屋里这么久。

source: Plus, I’m not complaining about some extra pizza~
translation: 而且能多吃几块披萨，我可不会抱怨～

source: I agree with Yoichi for once! We need some nutritious food back in our bodies!
translation: 这次我同意Yoichi！我们需要给身体补充一些营养食物！

source: Ugh, way to make it sound lame, Mr. Perfect.
translation: 呃，你这么一说就很无聊了，Mr. Perfect。

source: Haha, it sounds like you guys have had your own struggles with the storm the last few days.
translation: 哈哈，听起来过去几天里，你们也一直在和暴风雪作斗争。

source: It’s not been too bad, but like Hiro said, we weren’t really prepared to be stuck indoors.
translation: 还不算太糟，不过就像Hiro说的，我们没准备好被困在室内。

source: We didn’t have much of a choice but to order out.
translation: 我们别无选择，只能叫外卖。

source: Yeah… My sister and I aren’t great cooks, ahehe…
translation: 是啊……我和姐姐都不擅长做饭，啊嘿嘿……

source: Hehe, well feel free to eat as much as you want here, boys! There’s plenty for everyone~
translation: 嘿嘿，那就在这里尽情吃吧，小伙子们！每个人都有足够的食物～

source: Let’s go, everyone!
translation: 开吃吧，各位！

source: H-How do you always manage to pull off things like this on such short notice, Yuri?
translation: 尤、Yuri，你怎么总能在这么短的时间里办成这种事？

source: Hihi, we have plenty of people and supplies for a party! It’s all about your drive and motivation~
translation: 嘻嘻，我们有充足的人手和派对用品！关键就是干劲和动力～

source: Plus, I had my sturdy, manly, scoutmasters to help me move things around and decorate!
translation: 而且还有强壮又有男子气概的童子军长们帮我搬东西、做装饰！

source: Oh yeah, where is everyone else? They all ran off suddenly and I haven’t seen them yet…
translation: 哦，对了，其他人在哪里？他们突然全都跑掉，我一直没见到……

source: These pants are really short and tight…
translation: 这条裤子又短又紧……

source: Hurr durr. Do you know… the muffin man?
translation: 哈啦呼啦。你知不知道……松饼人？

source: Ugh… I should’ve known you would make me an elf, out of all things…
translation: 呃……我早该想到，那么多选择里，你偏偏会让我扮精灵……

source: I think you look cute. I like your legs.
translation: 我觉得你很可爱。我喜欢你的腿。

source: Awwwww~!!! Look at you, Lloyd! You’re like a fun-sized toy! Darius can play with you all night, hihi~
translation: 哎呀——～！！！看看你，Lloyd！就像一件迷你玩具！Darius能玩你一整晚，嘻嘻～

source: See, I told you they’d laugh at me!
translation: 看吧，我就说他们会笑我！

source: They’re not laughing at you; they’re laughing with you.
translation: 他们不是在嘲笑你，而是和你一起笑。

source: Ugh… Easy for you to say… You have such a cool costume! You’re lucky that you’re wearing something less embarrassing.
translation: 呃……你当然说得轻松……你的服装这么酷！很幸运，至少没那么丢人。

source: Which part of this is less embarassing...? I look like Willy Wanker.
translation: 这哪里不丢人了……？我看起来像个傻缺。

source: Don’t be shy, Lloyd! Go straight for that sweet surprise he’s hiding, I’m sure it’s extra-large and full of flavor!
translation: 别害羞，Lloyd！直接去品尝他藏着的甜蜜惊喜吧，我相信一定超大而且风味十足！

source: *sigh* I guess Yoichi was right about the costumes…
translation: *叹气* 看来Yoichi对这些服装的评价没错……

source: I’m surprised that the other staff are okay with this.
translation: 我很惊讶其他员工居然能接受。

source: You know, after working with Yuri for a few months, you get used to it.
translation: 你知道，和Yuri共事几个月后，就会习惯了。

source: H-Hehe… I really like this event, Yuri… It reminds me of the filler arcs in anime specifically made for fanservice!
translation: 嘿、嘿嘿……我真的很喜欢这次活动，Yuri……让我想起动漫里专门用来发福利的原创篇章！

source: But…
translation: 可是……

source: I didn’t expect to be included! I thought I was just going to be the observer!!
translation: 没想到自己也包括在内！我以为只需要当观察者！！

source: This outfit feels a bit contradictory, too… I’m an angel, but I’m definitely not having pure thoughts!
translation: 这套服装也有点矛盾……我扮的是天使，脑子里的想法却绝对不纯洁！

source: Hihi, but that makes it all the more tantalizing! And your cute twink body blends right in with everyone!
translation: 嘻嘻，但这样才更诱人！而且你可爱的纤细小受身材，和大家完美融合！

source: Kyaaa~! I can see you being manhandled by the other two, though!
translation: 呀啊～！我已经能想象你被另外两个人粗暴摆弄了！

source: You can count on them to take you to heaven!
translation: 你可以指望他们把你送上天堂！

source: Guuuuuuuhhhhhhhh…!! Stop making scenarios in my head! I’m getting a nosebleed just thinking about it!
translation: 咕呃呃呃呃……！！别再往我脑子里塞场景了！光是想想就要流鼻血！

source: Uhh… Dear… I think the outfit you gave me is a tad small…
translation: 呃……亲爱的……你给我的服装好像有点小……

source: Why can’t you just let me wear the costume I had from the last party?
translation: 为什么不能让我穿上次派对的服装？

source: No way! That was such a missed opportunity!
translation: 绝对不行！那简直是错失良机！

source: I could’ve made you wear something much better like a grunge leather daddy, a gladiator, or a caveman! Ugh… the wasted potential!
translation: 我本来可以让你穿更棒的服装，比如颓废皮革猛男、角斗士或穴居人！呃……潜力全浪费了！

source: I made sure not to make the same mistake again! You’re keeping that on, whether you like it or not!
translation: 我保证不会再犯同样的错误！不管喜不喜欢，你都得一直穿着！

source: *sigh* This is rather embarrassing, especially considering Mr. Clermont is attending this party…
translation: *叹气* 这实在很难为情，尤其是Clermont先生也参加了派对……

source: I beg to differ; I’ve never felt so alive! It’s been years since I’ve had this much fun!
translation: 恕我不能苟同；我从未感觉如此有活力！已经好多年没玩得这么开心了！

source: M-Mr. Clermont…?!
translation: 克、Clermont先生……？！

source: Back at the firm everyone is so stiff and formal – I’d love to be around people who can have a good time more often!
translation: 公司里的每个人都拘谨又正式——我真想更常和懂得享乐的人待在一起！

source: See? Mr. Clermont knows how to have fun!
translation: 看吧？Clermont先生懂得怎么享受！

source: S-Sir, I can’t believe you’re really wearing that…
translation: 先、先生，真不敢相信您真的穿了那套……

source: I’m starting to rethink my decision about staying here…
translation: 我开始重新考虑留在这里的决定了……

source: Kyaaaaaa!!! Emilia! You look soooo preeeettyyy!
translation: 呀啊啊啊！！！Emilia！你看起来太——漂亮了！

source: R-Really?
translation: 真、真的吗？

source: Yes! That ice queen costume suits you so well! Finally, a lady I can dress up as well!
translation: 当然！那套冰雪女王服装太适合你了！终于有一位女士也能让我打扮！

source: At least you chose something that matches me.
translation: 至少你选择了符合我形象的东西。

source: That was supposed to be my costume this year, but it fits you so much better!
translation: 那本来是我今年要穿的服装，但它显然更适合你！

source: I’d say I’m impressed considering this is a cheap costume from the party store.
translation: 考虑到这只是派对用品店的廉价服装，我得说确实令人惊艳。

source: Heeey, I put in a lot of work refitting them to everyone’s measurements! I’ve altered them to fit each of your personalities too!
translation: 喂——，我可是花了很多功夫，按照每个人的尺寸重新裁改！还做了修改，让服装符合各自的性格！

source: I don’t know how you even find the time, dear…
translation: 真不知道你怎么挤得出时间，亲爱的……

source: It wasn’t just me, Jin helped me plan them out too!
translation: 不只是我，Jin也帮忙规划了！

source: Shhh! Don’t throw me under the bus, Yuri!
translation: 嘘！别把我供出来，Yuri！

source: Haha, I think it’s sweet you made these for everyone, Yuri.
translation: 哈哈，我觉得你替大家制作这些服装很贴心，Yuri。

source: Says the guy not in one yet.
translation: 这话居然是还没穿服装的人说的。

source: W-Well, I haven’t seen Aiden yet either!
translation: 这、这个嘛，我也还没见到Aiden！

source: Oh, he’s still cleaning up the kitchen. He really pulled through, cooking the party food at the last minute!
translation: 哦，他还在清理厨房。临时准备派对食物，他真的出色完成了任务！

source: I’ve already given him his costume too! I can’t wait to see him in it~
translation: 我也已经把服装给他了！真等不及看他穿上的样子～

source: *sigh* You really were overprepared for this, Yuri…
translation: *叹气* 你为这件事准备得也太充分了，Yuri……

source: Hihi, I HAVE been planning this ever since our costume party, but I thought it would only be the four of us.
translation: 嘻嘻，自从上次化装舞会后，我确实一直在计划，不过原本以为只有我们四个人。

source: Once the project started, I added the other’s costumes, but with the hotel vacation, I thought there wasn’t going to be time.
translation: 项目开始后，我又增加了其他人的服装；可安排酒店度假后，我以为不会有时间。

source: I’m glad we were able to find a way to still celebrate it!
translation: 很高兴最后还是找到了庆祝的办法！

source: It’s a bummer that the scouts don’t have a costume, though…
translation: 不过童子军没有服装，真让人扫兴……

source: We’re lucky the hats were left over from last year’s party!
translation: 幸好还有去年派对剩下的帽子！

source: Anyway, quit stalling! Go get in your costume and fetch Aiden!
translation: 总之，别拖延了！快穿上服装，再把Aiden叫来！

source: Yeah! It’s not fair that we’re the only ones feeling embarrassed about this!
translation: 是啊！只有我们为这些服装感到难为情，太不公平了！

source: Alright, alright.
translation: 好吧，好吧。

source: {i}Not wanting to aggravate Yuri, I went into the bathroom and put my costume on before heading to the kitchen to find Aiden…{/i}
translation: {i}为了不惹Yuri生气，我走进浴室换上服装，然后前往厨房寻找Aiden……{/i}

source: Hey, Aiden! Are you h—
translation: 嘿，Aiden！你在——

source: Oh, hey Yoshi!
translation: 哦，嘿，Yoshi！

source: Whoa! Wh-What are you wearing?!
translation: 哇！你、你穿的是什么？！

source: Eh… I’m not sure… Yuri just told me to put this on.
translation: 呃……我也不知道……Yuri只是让我穿上。

source: These costumes really are… something…
translation: 这些服装真的……很特别……

source: Tell me about it. Somehow, she managed to make mine even more revealing than last year’s!
translation: 可不是嘛。不知道怎么做到的，她让我的服装比去年还暴露！

source: Hahaha! Okay, that’s a fair point. It is a little chilly in this now, though.
translation: 哈哈哈！好吧，说得有道理。不过现在穿这个确实有点冷。

source: Your costumes are consistent, at least. Just like last time, I can see your ‘thing’ bulging so shamelessly…
translation: 至少你的服装风格很一致。和上次一样，我能看到你的“东西”毫不害臊地鼓起来……

source: So, that’s where you’re staring, huh~? Looks like someone’s wanting to get out of his winter blues~
translation: 所以你一直盯着那里，对吧～？看来某人想摆脱冬日忧郁～

source: Not that I blame you though, I’m feeling frisky after a few days too~
translation: 不过也不怪你，憋了几天后，我也开始欲火焚身～

source: So… How do I look?
translation: 所以……我看起来怎么样？

source: So… How do I look? {fast}
translation: 所以……我看起来怎么样？{fast}

source: They say looks match what we’re feeling, so why don’t you find out if it’s true~
translation: 人们都说外表反映内心感受，不如你来验证一下是不是真的～

source: One-horse open sleigh.
translation: 一匹马拉的敞篷雪橇。

source: Like a one-horse open sleigh.
translation: 像一辆一匹马拉的敞篷雪橇。

source: Hehe, well I have a free ticket to ride here, just for you~
translation: 嘿嘿，这里有一张免费乘骑券，只给你一个人～

source: Oh yeah?
translation: 是吗？

source: Then why don’t I fill you up?
translation: 那就让我把你填满吧？

source: You look like you're ready for a ride.
translation: 你看起来已经准备好被骑了。

source: You look like you’re ready for a ride.
translation: 你看起来已经准备好被骑了。

source: Oh yeah?
translation: 是吗？

source: Is your inner cowboy calling for action?
translation: 你内心的牛仔正在召唤行动吗？

source: I’m supposed to be the reindeer, but you’re the one whose nose is turning red! Hahaha!
translation: 明明我才是驯鹿，可鼻子变红的人却是你！哈哈哈！

source: I-I can’t help it with you looking like that…! It’s driving me crazy!
translation: 你、你穿成这样，我根本控制不住……！快让我疯了！

source: Then come on over and open your present~
translation: 那就过来拆开你的礼物吧～

source: *sigh* This costume Yuri gave me is so tight-fitting… I can’t even button it all the way up…
translation: *叹气* Yuri给的这套服装太紧身了……扣子甚至无法全部扣上……

source: Hehe, you’re lucky you’re covered from the cold at least. I’m just relieved mine came with spare matching pants.
translation: 嘿嘿，至少你很幸运，衣服能抵御寒冷。我只庆幸自己的服装还附带了配套备用裤子。

source: Of all things she’d dress me in, why a nutcracker?
translation: 那么多东西可以打扮，为什么偏偏是胡桃夹子？

source: Aren’t you one? You just cracked mine a while ago, hahaha!
translation: 你不就是吗？刚才还把我的“坚果”夹爆了，哈哈哈！

source: I had that coming.
translation: 我活该听到这句。

source: Sshh, Aiden! Everyone can hear us…!
translation: 嘘，Aiden！所有人都会听见……！

source: There you two are! You missed the champagne popping! What took you so long?!
translation: 你们两个原来在这里！错过了开香槟！怎么花了这么久？！

source: *whistles*
translation: *吹口哨*

source: A-Ah… Well… We just had a bit of trouble with our costumes…
translation: 啊、啊……这个嘛……我们的服装出了点小问题……

source: Yeah, and we had to clean up a spill on the kitchen floor *wink*
translation: 是啊，而且得清理厨房地板上洒出来的东西。*眨眼*

source: Hey! Why are you two acting so sus?
translation: 喂！你们两个为什么这么可疑？

source: You know what? Nevermind. Just come join the party already! Everyone’s doing their own thing now!
translation: 算了，不问了。快来参加派对吧！大家现在都在各玩各的！

source: So, what do you wanna do for the night, Yoshi?
translation: 那么，今晚想做什么，Yoshi？

source: Enjoy the buffet.
translation: 享用自助餐。

source: Hangout and talk.
translation: 闲逛聊天。

source: Have drinks.
translation: 喝酒。

source: No idea.
translation: 不知道。

source: I’m actually kind of hungry, so let’s go get some food!
translation: 其实我有点饿了，我们去拿些食物吧！

source: Hehe, you worked up an appetite in there, didn’t you~?
translation: 嘿嘿，你刚才在里面运动出了胃口，对吧～？

source: Aiden! Am I gonna have to deal with your dirty puns all night?
translation: Aiden！我今晚要一直忍受你的下流双关吗？

source: Yup! You know that by now!
translation: 没错！你早就该知道了！

source: Shubby Funny!
translation: 胖乎乎伙哇！

source: Bahaha! That’s six marshmallows, no way you can handle more!
translation: 哇哈哈！已经六颗棉花糖了，你绝对塞不下更多！

source: I fan foo!
translation: 我饭以！

source: What was that? I can’t understand you, hahaha!
translation: 你说什么？我听不懂，哈哈哈！

source: Uhhh… What’s going on over here?
translation: 呃……这里在做什么？

source: Actually, we aren’t sure either.
translation: 其实我们也不确定。

source: They’re playing a game.
translation: 他们在玩游戏。

source: Yup! It’s called ‘chubby buddy!’
translation: 没错！叫作“胖乎乎伙伴”！

source: You see how many marshmallows you can fit in your mouth while saying ‘Chubby Buddy.’
translation: 看看嘴里能塞多少颗棉花糖，同时还要说出“胖乎乎伙伴”。

source: Torch-head’s record is six, and mine is ten!
translation: Torch-head的纪录是六颗，我是十颗！

source: There’s plenty of delicious food to enjoy and they decide to do this instead.
translation: 明明有那么多美味食物可以享用，他们却决定玩这个。

source: Haha, maybe it’s their dessert!
translation: 哈哈，也许这就是他们的甜点！

source: It’s been fun to watch them.
translation: 看他们玩很有趣。

source: Well, quit watching and join us then, Pipsqueak!
translation: 好了，别光看，加入我们，Pipsqueak！

source: Huh?! No way! That sounds embarrassing! And would you stop calling me that?!
translation: 什么？！才不要！听起来很丢人！而且能不能别再这么叫我？！

source: It’s not, it’s fun! Plus, you get to eat a bunch of marshmallows~
translation: 才不丢人，很好玩！而且还能吃一大堆棉花糖～

source: That sounds terrible for my body! I can’t have that much sugar in one sitting!
translation: 听起来对身体太糟糕了！我不能一次摄入那么多糖！

source: Dar! You do it!
translation: Dar！你来玩！

source: I do like marshmallows. I put them in my cocoa all the time.
translation: 我确实喜欢棉花糖。喝可可时总会放进去。

source: Hell yeah! Come over here and try then.
translation: 太好了！过来试试。

source: How does this work again?
translation: 规则是什么来着？

source: It’s super easy! Just put a marshmallow in your mouth and say ‘Chubby Buddy!’
translation: 超级简单！只要把一颗棉花糖放进嘴里，再说“胖乎乎伙伴”！

source: Chubby Buddy.
translation: 胖乎乎伙伴。

source: That’s one! Try another!
translation: 一颗！再来一颗！

source: This is taking way too long! Stack a bunch in there!
translation: 这样太慢了！一口气塞一大把！

source: Y-Yoichi, he just started—
translation: 洋、Yoichi，他才刚开始——

source: It’s fine.
translation: 没关系。

source: Here! Take ten!
translation: 来！拿十颗！

source: Mmf!
translation: 嗯唔！

source: Now say it!
translation: 现在说出来！

source: Ch-Chubby Buddy.
translation: 胖、胖乎乎伙伴。

source: What the hell?! He can still talk?!
translation: 搞什么？！他居然还能说话？！

source: Haha, there goes your record you stupid Wolfboy!
translation: 哈哈，你的纪录没了，笨蛋Wolfboy！

source: Woah, way to go Dar!
translation: 哇，干得好，Dar！

source: Yeah, you must be used to stuffing things in your mouth, huh bro?
translation: 是啊，你一定很习惯往嘴里塞东西，对吧兄弟？

source: A-Aiden!
translation: 艾、Aiden！

source: Here! Take three more!
translation: 来！再拿三颗！

source: M-Mmgh…
translation: 嗯、嗯唔……

source: Sh…Soggy Daddy.
translation: 湿……湿透老爹。

source: Hah! There’s the limit!
translation: 哈！到极限了！

source: That’s seventeen marshmallows though! That was basically the whole bag!
translation: 可那是十七颗棉花糖！基本上一整袋了！

source: A-Are you okay, Dar? That didn’t choke you, did it?
translation: 你、你没事吧，Dar？没有噎到吧？

source: Nope, it was tasty.
translation: 没有，很好吃。

source: I didn’t expect he’d play along. Thought you were just a boring giant.
translation: 没想到他会配合。我还以为你只是个无聊的巨人。

source: Oh boy, you don’t know the half of it. Dar might not look it, but he’s quite the comedian, too!
translation: 天啊，你根本不了解。Dar看起来不像，但他也很有喜剧天赋！

source: Thanks, Shorty Hubby.
translation: 谢谢，矮个老公。

source: Hey, the game’s over already! And you’re not supposed to call me nicknames too, Dar!
translation: 喂，游戏已经结束了！而且你也不该给我起绰号，Dar！

source: Now I wanna see if Bro-Aiden and Scoutmaster Yoshi can beat Darius’ record!
translation: 现在我想看看Aiden大哥和Yoshi童子军长能不能打破Darius的纪录！

source: Alright! I’ll go grab some more mallows!
translation: 好！我再去拿些棉花糖！

source: Wait…! Are we really going to—
translation: 等等……！我们真要——

source: Yes, you are! No backing out now!
translation: 没错！现在不准退出！

source: And you’re not out of the woods yet, Pipsqueak!
translation: 而你也还没逃过这一劫，Pipsqueak！

source: Wh-What?! I already said no!
translation: 什、什么？！我已经说不要了！

source: Don’t worry, Lloyd. You’ve stuffed bigger things in your mouth.
translation: 别担心，Lloyd。你嘴里塞过更大的东西。

source: D-Dar!!
translation: 达、Dar！！

source: {i}Yoichi and Hiro kept getting Aiden, Lloyd, Darius and I to play ‘interesting’ games with them and we ended up having a lot of fun!{/i}
translation: {i}Yoichi和Hiro不断拉着Aiden、Lloyd、Darius还有我，一起玩各种“有趣”的游戏，最后大家都玩得非常开心！{/i}

source: Let’s just relax and chat for a bit!
translation: 我们放松一下，聊会儿天吧！

source: Yeah, I wouldn’t mind taking it easy after working up a sweat~
translation: 是啊，出了一身汗后，我不介意轻松休息一下～

source: Do you mean from the cooking, or…?
translation: 你是说做饭出的汗，还是……？

source: Come on, Yoshi. You already know the answer.
translation: 拜托，Yoshi。你早就知道答案。

source: Hngh…
translation: 嗯哼……

source: *sigh* Yeah, I figured. Every time we do it, you get materials for fresh jokes.
translation: *叹气* 是啊，我就知道。我们每做一次，你就会获得新的笑话素材。

source: Do… it…?
Haha, yup! But you were the instigator tonight, Yoshi~
translation: 哈哈，没错！不过今晚先挑起事情的人是你，Yoshi～

source: You’re not wrong. Even now, your costume is still a tease.
translation: 你说得没错。即使现在，你的服装仍然充满挑逗。

source: Such a tease…
translation: 真会勾引人……

source: Uh, Yoshi? Why is Jin peeking over there?
translation: 呃，Yoshi？Jin为什么躲在那里偷看？

source: Huh? Jin, what are you doing?
translation: 嗯？Jin，你在做什么？

source: O-Oh no, I’ve been spotted…!
translation: 哦、哦不，我被发现了……！
