source: Jin! Come over here, lemme check out your costume!
translation: Jin！过来，让我看看你的服装！

source: *gulp* A-Alright…
translation: *咽口水* 好、好的……

source: Oho~ You’re showing a lot of skin in that outfit, I see! With some muscles, you could put mine to shame, haha!
translation: 哦嚯～看来这套衣服露出了很多皮肤！要是再练点肌肉，说不定能让我都自愧不如，哈哈！

source: I-I beg to differ…
translation: 恕、恕我不能同意……

source: Jin, is your nose bleeding again…?
translation: Jin，你鼻子又流血了吗……？

source: I-I’m fine, I’m just getting woozy from the view.
translation: 我、我没事，只是眼前的景色让我有点晕。

source: I’ll get you some tissues.
translation: 我去给你拿纸巾。

source: A-Alright… I might need them for a different reason, though…
translation: 好、好的……不过我可能会因为另一个原因需要它们……

source: Did I hear tissues?! The cleanliness police are here to the rescue!
translation: 我听到有人需要纸巾？！清洁警察来救援了！

source: H-Here you go, Scoutmaster Yoshi…
translation: 给、给您，Yoshi童子军长……

source: O-Oh, thanks Natsumi and Hunter…!
translation: 哦、哦，谢谢Natsumi和Hunter……！

source: You’re most welcome, sir! We’re here to make sure the party is as smooth and TIDY as possible!
translation: 不用客气，先生！我们会确保派对尽可能顺利而整洁！

source: Eh? You’re supposed to be having fun, not cleaning, you two!
translation: 诶？你们两个应该好好玩，而不是打扫卫生！

source: Yeah, Natsumi… We’ve been working all day, surely you can take this chance to enjoy the time with everyone!
translation: 是啊，Natsumi……我们已经工作了一整天，你当然可以趁机和大家一起享受时光！

source: *sigh* That’s what I’ve been telling him… But he’s so excited to clean up for some reason.
translation: *叹气* 我一直这么告诉他……可不知道为什么，他特别兴奋地想打扫。

source: Well, I don’t want it to end like our last costume party, with the scoutmasters cleaning up after us.
translation: 这个嘛，我不想像上次化装舞会那样，最后由童子军长替我们收拾。

source: W-Wait, you had a costume party during the summer too?
translation: 等、等等，你们夏天也举办过化装舞会？

source: We did! And Ms. Yuri had a whole bunch of costumes for us to choose from then!
translation: 没错！当时Yuri小姐准备了一大堆服装让我们挑选！

source: I was a police officer, and Scoutmaster Yoshi was a sheriff! We were kind of like a dynamic duo!
translation: 我扮警察，Yoshi童子军长扮警长！我们有点像黄金搭档！

source: S-So figures of authority… I guess that means you’re both the tops…
translation: 所、所以都是权威人物……我猜这意味着你们两个都是攻……

source: Meanwhile, Hunter was a play-bunny boy! It was actually a really cute outfit~
translation: 与此同时，Hunter扮的是兔男郎！那套衣服真的非常可爱～

source: You say that, Natsumi, but it was kind of embarrassing…
translation: 你这么说，Natsumi，但那其实很让人难为情……

source: Hnnghhh… I can’t believe I missed out…
translation: 嗯啊……真不敢相信我错过了……

source: It was a ton of fun! We have lots of stories about it, haha!
translation: 当时特别好玩！我们有很多故事可以讲，哈哈！

source: W-Well, if you’re interested, we could write a blog post for it too!
translation: 这、这个嘛，如果你们有兴趣，我们也可以为那次活动写一篇博客！

source: Oh, you have your own blog, Mr. Jin?
translation: 哦，您有自己的博客吗，Jin先生？

source: P-Please, just call me Jin!
translation: 请、请直接叫我Jin！

source: And not exactly. It’s actually for Camp Buddy.
translation: 而且不完全是。其实那是伙伴营的博客。

source: Yup! We’re actually chronicling the memories going all the way back to my term as a scout to post on there!
translation: 没错！我们正在记录从我当童子军时期一直到现在的回忆，准备发布上去！

source: Oh wow! Like a camp history!
translation: 哇哦！就像营地历史！

source: That sounds really cool…!
translation: 听起来真的很酷……！

source: So, you want to help? I’d love to hear more about the party!
translation: 那么，你们想帮忙吗？我很想听到更多派对故事！

source: Especially the costumes…
translation: 尤其是服装……

source: Sure! We’d love to!
translation: 当然！我们很乐意！

source: Want to join us, Scoutmaster Yoshi and Sir Aiden?
translation: Yoshi童子军长、Aiden先生，你们想加入吗？

source: Yeah, totally! After all, I’m sure Jin would wanna hear what costume I had on that night~
translation: 当然想！毕竟我相信Jin很想听听那晚我穿了什么服装～

source: *gulp* Wh-What was it…?
translation: *咽口水* 是、是什么……？

source: Sir Aiden was dressed up like an ancient pharaoh…
translation: Aiden先生打扮成了古代法老……

source: Oh, that reminds me…! Were you able to take off the ring stuck on your thing?
translation: 哦，这提醒我了……！你最后把卡在那东西上的圆环取下来了吗？

source: R-Ring? Th-Thing…?
translation: 圆、圆环？那、那东西……？

source: *ehem* Let’s not confuse Jin here… Let’s just tell him how the party went for the blog.
translation: *咳咳* 别让Jin困惑……还是只告诉他派对的经过，写进博客吧。

source: Don’t forget about the after party~
translation: 别忘了派对后的活动～

source: Oh my… Let me get my laptop and we’ll get started!
translation: 哦，天哪……让我拿来笔记本，我们马上开始！

source: Coming!
translation: 来了！

source: Ahh… The grass feels good on my back.
translation: 啊……草地贴着后背真舒服。

source: I know right? It’s been a while since we hung out here. And it looks like we got the whole pier to ourselves!
translation: 对吧？我们已经很久没在这里闲逛了。而且整座码头好像都归我们！

source: I don’t mind that – I could use the peace and quiet. Hosting the party tonight really drained me.
translation: 我不介意——正需要这份宁静。今晚主持派对真的耗尽了精力。

source: Thanks for helping me clean up earlier, Aiden! I know you were already tired from cooking the food too.
translation: 谢谢你刚才帮我打扫，Aiden！我知道做完食物后，你也已经很累了。

source: No problem, always at your service! Everything seemed to go well tonight, too.
translation: 没问题，随时为你效劳！而且今晚的一切似乎都很顺利。

source: Yeah, it’s been such a long week working with the scouts on the fundraiser, and this was a great way to celebrate.
translation: 是啊，和童子军一起为筹款忙碌了漫长的一周，这正是绝佳的庆祝方式。

source: You bet! I’d say everyone had extra fun with Yuri’s costume party idea.
translation: 当然！我觉得Yuri的化装舞会点子，让每个人都玩得格外开心。

source: Especially you, Yoshi~
translation: 尤其是你，Yoshi～

source: You might as well be an archeologist with all digging you’ve been doing with those eyes.
translation: 你一直用眼睛四处挖掘，简直可以去当考古学家。

source: I know that look when I see it~
translation: 那种眼神我一看就懂～

source: *ehem* I’ve been trying hard not to look your way, especially since Yuri gave you such a revealing costume.
translation: *咳咳* 我一直努力不看你，尤其是Yuri给了你这么暴露的服装。

source: Uh-huh~
translation: 嗯哼～

source: D-Don’t get me wrong, it really suits you. You look really good in it, in fact…
translation: 别、别误会，它真的很适合你。事实上，你穿起来特别好看……

source: You too! You really make the perfect sexy cowboy~
translation: 你也是！你真是完美的性感牛仔～

source: But then again, your wild west style makes me wild and wet.
translation: 话说回来，你的西部风格让我狂野又湿润。

source: There you go teasing me again, Aiden.
translation: 你又在挑逗我了，Aiden。

source: Haha! Can’t help it, you make it so easy for me!
translation: 哈哈！没办法，谁让你这么容易被逗！

source: M-Maybe we should’ve gotten changed first before chilling out here.
translation: 也、也许来这里放松前，应该先换掉服装。

source: I wish I could! Trust me I tried, but that ring’s stuck on there!
translation: 我也想！相信我，已经试过了，但那个圆环卡在那里！

source: R-Ring…? Y-You mean the one’s that’s on your…
translation: 圆、圆环……？你、你是说套在你……

source: *sigh* Why did you even put it there in the first place…
translation: *叹气* 你一开始为什么要把它套在那里……

source: Well, maybe you can help me take it off~?
translation: 这个嘛，也许你能帮我取下来～？

source: Here, lemme give you a clearer view~
translation: 来，让你看得更清楚～

source: {i}After such a long week, I didn’t even try to resist Aiden as he pulled himself up from the grass and positioned himself right on top me.{/i}
translation: {i}经历漫长的一周后，当Aiden从草地上起身，骑到我身上时，我甚至没有尝试抵抗。{/i}

source: {i}I laid down on my back, eager for what came next…{/i}
translation: {i}我仰面躺下，期待接下来发生的一切……{/i}

source: So… Did the ring ever come off?
translation: 所以……那个圆环最后取下来了吗？

source: Yup! But let’s just say it took some special lube~
translation: 当然！不过只能说，我们用了一些特殊的润滑剂～

source: *ehem* I think that’s enough for that story! Jin’s got plenty for his blog!
translation: *咳咳* 这个故事讲到这里就够了！Jin已经有足够的博客素材！

source: I-I could use some more details… It sounds like Aiden was about to get to the juicy part.
translation: 我、我还能再听些细节……听起来Aiden正要讲到最有汁水的部分。

source: Oh, there were plenty of juices, alright~
translation: 哦，汁水确实多得很～

source: HNGH…!! Please do a re-enactment right now!
translation: 嗯啊……！！请现在马上重演！

source: SEND THIS ANGEL BOY TO BL HEAVEN!
translation: 把这个天使男孩送上BL天堂！

source: He really is just like Ms. Yuri…
translation: 他真的和Yuri小姐一模一样……

source: {i}We worked on the blog with Natsumi and Hunter, excitedly telling Jin stories from the previous term.{/i}
translation: {i}我们与Natsumi和Hunter一起制作博客，兴奋地向Jin讲述上期活动的故事。{/i}

source: Let’s go have some drinks!
translation: 我们去喝几杯吧！

source: Now we’re talking!
translation: 这才对嘛！

source: I see Gramps and Mr. Clermont doing just that over there! Let’s join ’em!
translation: 我看到Gramps和Clermont先生正在那边喝！我们加入他们！

source: Good evening! Mind if we join in?
translation: 晚上好！介意我们加入吗？

source: Ah, Yoshinori, please take a seat!
translation: 啊，Yoshinori，请坐！

source: Heh, Yuri can’t impose our liquor ban now, so we’re drinking ’til the sun goes up!
translation: 呵，Yuri现在不能执行禁酒令，所以我们要喝到太阳升起！

source: Whoa, whoa, Gramps! You don’t wanna be a sobbing mess in front of our sponsor!
translation: 哇，等等，Gramps！你不会想当着赞助商的面哭成一团吧！

source: *ehem* Don’t listen to him, Mr. Clermont.
translation: *咳咳* 别听他的，Clermont先生。

source: Isn’t it amusing to see a bunch of grown men in such costumes enjoying a tall glass of beer?
translation: 看到一群成年男人穿着这种服装畅饮大杯啤酒，不是很有趣吗？

source: *sigh* I hope it’s not too unbecoming of your prestigious reputation, sir.
translation: *叹气* 希望这不会太有损您的尊贵声誉，先生。

source: Come on, Goro. We’re outside the workspace now, we can be more personal and call each other by our names!
translation: 拜托，Goro。现在不在工作场合，可以亲近一点，直接叫彼此的名字！

source: Th-Thank you, sir, but it would feel far too inappropriate…
translation: 谢、谢谢您，先生，但那样感觉太不合适了……

source: Haha, whatever you like, then!
translation: 哈哈，那就随你喜欢！

source: Good evening, sirs! I hope I’m not interrupting, but I brought some oysters…! I heard they go well with beer!
translation: 晚上好，各位先生！希望没有打扰你们，我带了一些牡蛎……！听说它们很配啤酒！

source: That’s perfect, Keitaro. Thanks. Who taught you that, though?
translation: 太好了，Keitaro。谢谢。不过是谁教你的？

source: *ehem* Yours truly~
translation: *咳咳* 正是在下～

source: Ah, Mr. Nagame, why don’t you sit here with us for a moment?
translation: 啊，Nagame先生，为什么不坐下来陪我们聊一会儿？

source: O-Oh! I-I’m sorry, I don’t drink, sir…!
translation: 哦、哦！抱、抱歉，我不喝酒，先生……！

source: Well, just for some small talk! There’s something I’ve been meaning to tell your scoutmasters!
translation: 这个嘛，只是聊聊天！有些事我一直想告诉你们的童子军长！

source: O-Okay, sir…!
translation: 好、好的，先生……！

source: So, as we all know, Mr. Nagame’s book from last term was one of our bestselling novels in a long time!
translation: 那么，大家都知道，Nagame先生上期写的书，是我们很长时间以来最畅销的小说之一！

source: Does that make him a world-renowned author now? Haha!
translation: 这是不是意味着他现在成了世界知名作家？哈哈！

source: I-I don’t know about that, Sir Aiden, hehe…
translation: 这、这个我可不敢当，Aiden先生，嘿嘿……

source: It’s actually a fairly accurate statement! Why, we’re already working on several foreign language translations for your work as well!
translation: 其实这个说法相当准确！我们已经在为你的作品制作多种外语译本！

source: With any luck, we’ll have them out soon and reach an even broader audience.
translation: 如果一切顺利，很快就能推出，让作品触达更广泛的读者。

source: Th-This is really surreal, sir…
translation: 这、这真的太不真实了，先生……

source: Haha, I’m sure, which is what brings me to what I’ve wanted to say…
translation: 哈哈，我能理解，这也正好引出我一直想说的事……

source: Considering the book’s success, I’ve personally offered Mr. Nagame here a percentage of the sales.
translation: 鉴于这本书的成功，我亲自向Nagame先生提出，给他一定比例的销售分成。

source: Whoa! Does that mean you’re rich now, Keitaro?!
translation: 哇！这是不是意味着你现在发财了，Keitaro？！

source: That’s the thing. He declined the offer.
translation: 问题就在这里。他拒绝了。

source: Wh-What? Why?
translation: 什、什么？为什么？

source: I-I figured I couldn’t have done it if it weren’t for Camp Buddy, so it was better to put it into the sponsorship.
translation: 我、我觉得如果没有伙伴营，根本写不出这本书，所以最好把钱投入赞助。

source: Yes! And that’s exactly what we did!
translation: 没错！我们正是这么做的！

source: While this expansion project’s funding is a separate investment for me, I’ve made sure to respect Mr. Nagame’s wishes, and pool in his royalties alongside this sponsorship!
translation: 虽然扩建项目的资金是我的另一项投资，但我尊重Nagame先生的意愿，将他的版税也投入了这次赞助！

source: I’m lost for words…
translation: 我不知道该说什么……

source: Th-Thank you so much, Keitaro!
translation: 太、太感谢你了，Keitaro！

source: I promise we’re doing our best to make it all worth it, so the camp can have an amazing future!
translation: 我保证大家会竭尽全力，让这一切物有所值，让营地拥有美好的未来！

source: Yes, sir! I can’t wait to be back for the next summer!
translation: 是，先生！我等不及明年夏天再回来了！

source: Good! Now come on, let’s have a toast!
translation: 很好！来，让我们举杯！

source: Hey, why didn’t you call everyone over for the booze?!
translation: 喂，喝酒为什么不叫大家？！

source: I don’t think we’re supposed to—
translation: 我觉得我们不应该——

source: Aha! So, you’re the one who took my oysters, Snow-BALLS!
translation: 啊哈！原来是你拿走了我的牡蛎，雪球蛋！

source: I believe he is referring to me.
translation: 我想他是在说我。

source: Y-Yoichi! Call him Mr. Clermont!
translation: 洋、Yoichi！应该叫Clermont先生！

source: Why not? He’s Snowball’s dad, and it’s what he looks like!
translation: 为什么不行？他是雪球的爸爸，而且看起来就是这样！

source: Are you referring to my son, Felix?
translation: 你说的是我的儿子Felix吗？

source: A-Ah, Yoichi here just likes to give out nicknames to people he likes, sir…
translation: 啊、啊，Yoichi只是喜欢给自己喜欢的人起绰号，先生……

source: Yeah! That’s Frogboy, he’s Geezer, and that’s Buttcheeks and Sheriff Brokeback!
translation: 没错！那是Frogboy，他是Geezer，还有Buttcheeks和Sheriff Brokeback！

source: *sigh* This is embarrassing…
translation: *叹气* 太丢人了……

source: Hahaha! What a fun idea! Tell me all the other nicknames you have, lad!
translation: 哈哈哈！真是个有趣的点子！小伙子，把其他绰号都告诉我！

source: Pour me a drink and you got it!
translation: 给我倒杯酒，我就告诉你！

source: So much for a peaceful evening…
translation: 安静的夜晚算是泡汤了……

source: {i}Aiden and I ended up spending the evening drinking with Mr. Clermont and Sir Goro, while the rest of the scouts ate and played games.{/i}
translation: {i}最后，我和Aiden与Clermont先生、Goro先生一起喝酒，而其他童子军则吃东西、玩游戏。{/i}

source: I don’t know, honestly. I’m pretty drained after working all day on site.
translation: 说实话，我不知道。在工地干了一整天，已经筋疲力尽了。

source: And you worked on me on top of that. Hahaha!
translation: 而且除此之外，你还在我身上卖力干过。哈哈哈！

source: Oh, Yoshi, look over there! Are you seeing what I’m seeing?
translation: 哦，Yoshi，看那边！你也看到了吗？

source: Emilia and Taiga talking to each other…? What an unlikely pair.
translation: Emilia和Taiga正在交谈……？真是意想不到的组合。

source: Let’s go check on them!
translation: 我们去看看！

source: Good evening, you two! Enjoying the party so far?
translation: 晚上好，你们两个！派对玩得开心吗？

source: It’s about time you got in costume too, Yoshi.
translation: Yoshi，你也总算穿上服装了。

source: What’s going on here? You two looked like you were talking about something serious.
translation: 这里在聊什么？你们两个看起来像是在谈严肃的事情。

source: Well… She was just telling me everything that happened while we were gone.
translation: 这个嘛……她刚才在告诉我，我们离开期间发生的一切。

source: And I was telling her about the last two terms.
translation: 而我在告诉她过去两期活动的事。

source: It seems that Taiga and I have a lot in common, believe it or not.
translation: 信不信由你，Taiga和我似乎有很多共同点。

source: Now that’s unexpected…
translation: 这确实出乎意料……

source: I guess I can understand why… You both went through a lot that you wanted to make up for.
translation: 我大概能理解为什么……你们都经历过许多想要弥补的事。

source: Exactly. But in my case, I’m just getting started.
translation: 正是如此。不过对我而言，一切才刚刚开始。

source: Well, you can make up for it faster than you think. Honestly, I feel so different from who I was half a year ago…
translation: 这个嘛，你弥补错误的速度可能比想象中更快。说实话，我感觉自己和半年前已经完全不同……

source: And I owe it to everyone here for giving me another chance.
translation: 这一切都要感谢这里的每个人愿意再给我一次机会。

source: We’re lucky we have lots of open-minded people who let stuff go.
translation: 我们很幸运，身边有很多心胸开阔、愿意放下过去的人。

source: And you’re right that I’ve got to put in the work too.
translation: 而且你说得对，我也必须付出努力。

source: I’m trying to think of ways to really show how much I’m willing to change…
translation: 我正在想办法，真正证明自己多么愿意改变……

source: You just recovered. You don’t have to pressure yourself like that, Emilia.
translation: 你才刚恢复，不必给自己这么大压力，Emilia。

source: Yeah, as long as you’re being genuine with your actions, things should work out fine!
translation: 是啊，只要行动出自真心，一切都会顺利！

source: No one’s keeping a check list of things you have to make up for, haha!
translation: 没人拿着清单，记录你必须弥补的每一件事，哈哈！

source: Yeah, or else I’d be less than halfway through the list.
translation: 是啊，否则我的清单连一半都还没完成。

source: Don’t give Yoichi any ideas either, or he’ll start using that as an excuse to boss me around.
translation: 也别给Yoichi任何灵感，否则他会以此为借口对我呼来喝去。

source: Hahaha! He totally would!
translation: 哈哈哈！他绝对会！

source: It’s still surreal though, you seem so calm and well-put together now for your age.
translation: 不过还是觉得不真实，以你的年纪而言，现在显得如此冷静而成熟。

source: I have a hard time imagining you being in a similar position as I was.
translation: 我很难想象你曾处于和我相似的境地。

source: Just ask everyone and they’ll tell you for sure.
translation: 随便问问大家，他们肯定会告诉你。

source: Yup! He was a real ball of angst! Yoichi was spot on calling him Dynamite, hahaha!
translation: 没错！他以前就是一团焦虑！Yoichi叫他“Dynamite”真是太准确了，哈哈哈！

source: Now I wonder what I’m going to be called from now on…
translation: 现在我开始好奇，今后自己会被叫什么……

source: Whatever it is, you’re better off just accepting the title, trust me.
translation: 不管是什么，最好直接接受这个称号，相信我。

source: I’m so happy to see you two bonding so well and owning up to your past actions like this!
translation: 看到你们两个关系这么融洽，还能这样直面过去的行为，我太高兴了！

source: Taiga, to think that you would be the scout who brings motivation to even your scoutmasters!
translation: Taiga，没想到你竟然会成为连童子军长都能鼓舞的童子军！

source: It brings a tear to my eye. Why I remember—
translation: 真让我感动落泪。我还记得——

source: Yoshi?! Are you monologuing again?!
translation: Yoshi？！你又开始长篇独白了吗？！

source: Oh, I was only acknowledging Taiga and Emilia’s redemption journey!
translation: 哦，我只是在赞扬Taiga和Emilia的救赎历程！

source: Haven’t you gushed over everyone enough today?!
translation: 你今天夸大家夸得还不够吗？！

source: See, this is why I didn’t ever want to listen to him back then.
translation: 看吧，这就是我当年从来不想听他说话的原因。

source: Come with me, you two! I have party games to play with everyone!
translation: 你们两个跟我来！我准备了派对游戏，要和大家一起玩！

source: Depends on what your definition of a ‘party game’ is.
translation: 这要看你对“派对游戏”的定义。

source: Well, I’m not risking it. I’m staying here.
translation: 好吧，我不冒这个险。我要留在这里。

source: Well, suit yourself~! It’s gonna be a boys-only strip show then!
translation: 好吧，随你便～！那就举办男生专属脱衣秀！

source: Wh-What?! I knew it…!
translation: 什、什么？！我就知道……！

source: You’re coming with me~
translation: 你得跟我走～

source: —And that’s why you should always strive to be honest with yourself, so you can… Wait a minute, where did Taiga go?
translation: ——所以应该始终努力忠于自己，这样才能……等等，Taiga去哪里了？

source: Haha, you got carried away with your speech again, Yoshi.
translation: 哈哈，你又沉浸在演讲里了，Yoshi。

source: Well, I don’t mind hearing more…! They always inspire me, believe it or not!
translation: 这个嘛，我不介意再多听一些……！信不信由你，这些话总能激励我！

source: See, Aiden? Emilia gets it! Now where was I…
translation: 看吧，Aiden？Emilia懂我！刚才说到哪里了……

source: *sigh* This is gonna be a real long night…
translation: *叹气* 今晚真的会很漫长……

source: {i}I continued to talk to Emilia for a little bit longer until Aiden and Taiga brought us some food.{/i}
translation: {i}我继续和Emilia聊了一会儿，直到Aiden和Taiga给我们拿来食物。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, after we finished, we joined the rest of the group and partied for the remainder of the evening!{/i}
translation: {i}最后，等我们聊完后，便加入其他人，继续享受余下的派对时光！{/i}
